Embark on a thrilling 6-day group safari through Tanzania’s most celebrated wildlife destinations perfectly crafted for adventure seekers, photographers, and nature enthusiasts who want exceptional value, comfort, and unforgettable wildlife encounters. This immersive journey takes you deep into three of the country’s most iconic parks: Tarangire National Park, home to vast elephant herds and ancient baobabs; the legendary Serengeti National Park, where big cats roam the endless plains; and the breathtaking Ngorongoro Crater, a natural haven for the rare and iconic Big Five. As you travel through these diverse landscapes, you’ll witness Africa’s most powerful predators, remarkable wildlife gatherings, and dramatic scenery that defines true safari magic. Guided by experienced professionals and supported by Mix Lodge and Public Campsite, this group safari offers a fun, friendly atmosphere and delivers an authentic, immersive, and unforgettable African experience from start to finish.

Embárquese en un emocionante safari en grupo de 6 días por los destinos de fauna más célebres de Tanzania, ideado para aventureros, fotógrafos y amantes de la naturaleza que quieren un valor excepcional, comodidad y encuentros inolvidables con la fauna. El viaje le lleva a tres de los parques más emblemáticos del país: Tarangire, con enormes manadas de elefantes y baobabs centenarios; el legendario Serengeti, donde los grandes felinos recorren llanuras sin fin; y el impresionante cráter del Ngorongoro, refugio de los cinco grandes. Verá a los depredadores más poderosos de África, concentraciones de fauna y paisajes que definen la magia del safari. Con guías profesionales y alojamiento combinado de lodge y camping público, este safari en grupo ofrece un ambiente divertido y cercano y una experiencia africana auténtica de principio a fin.

踏上精彩的6天拼团游猎之旅，走进坦桑尼亚最负盛名的野生动物胜地，专为追求超高性价比、舒适体验和难忘野生动物邂逅的探险者、摄影师和自然爱好者打造。您将深入全国最具代表性的三大公园：拥有庞大象群和古老猴面包树的塔兰吉雷国家公园；大型猫科动物驰骋于无垠草原的传奇塞伦盖蒂国家公园；以及非洲五霸的天然家园——壮丽的恩戈罗恩戈罗火山口。一路上，您将见证非洲最强大的捕食者、壮观的动物聚集和令人震撼的风光。专业向导带领，酒店与公共营地相结合，氛围轻松友好，带给您自始至终真实难忘的非洲体验。

After early breakfast, descend into Ngorongoro Crater for a full-day game drive in one of the world’s most wildlife-dense ecosystems. Encounter the Big Five—lion, leopard, elephant, buffalo, and rhino—along with diverse other species. Picnic lunch inside the crater. Ascend to the crater rim and return to Arusha for dinner and overnight.

Tras un desayuno temprano, descenso al cráter del Ngorongoro para un safari de día completo en uno de los ecosistemas con más fauna del mundo. Encuentro con los cinco grandes (león, leopardo, elefante, búfalo y rinoceronte) y muchas otras especies. Almuerzo pícnic dentro del cráter. Ascenso al borde y regreso a Arusha para cenar y dormir.
早早用过早餐，下到恩戈罗恩戈罗火山口，在全球野生动物最密集的生态系统之一全天游猎，邂逅非洲五霸——狮子、花豹、大象、水牛和犀牛——以及众多其他物种。火山口内野餐午餐。返回火山口边缘后回阿鲁沙晚餐住宿。

This safari takes you through some of the country’s most famous parks, including Tarangire National Park, the Central Serengeti, and the Ngorongoro Crater.

Su safari de 7 días empieza en Arusha antes de dirigirse al Parque Nacional de Tarangire, famoso por sus baobabs gigantes y grandes manadas de elefantes. Allí disfrutará de emocionantes recorridos observando leones, jirafas, cebras y numerosas aves.
您的7天之旅从阿鲁沙出发，前往以巨大猴面包树和庞大象群闻名的塔兰吉雷国家公园。在这里享受精彩游猎，观赏狮子、长颈鹿、斑马和众多鸟类。

The journey continues to the legendary plains of the Central Serengeti, the heart of Tanzania’s wildlife ecosystem. During this 7 Days Central Serengeti Safari, you will explore one of the best areas for spotting predators, including lions, leopards, and cheetahs that closely follow the migrating herds of wildebeest and zebras. The best time to witness this incredible movement of wildlife is between April–May and October–December.

El viaje continúa hasta las legendarias llanuras del Serengeti central, el corazón del ecosistema de Tanzania. Explorará una de las mejores zonas para ver depredadores, como leones, leopardos y guepardos, que siguen de cerca las manadas migratorias de ñus y cebras. La mejor época para presenciar este movimiento es de abril a mayo y de octubre a diciembre.
旅程继续前往传奇的塞伦盖蒂中部平原——坦桑尼亚野生动物生态系统的核心。您将探索观赏捕食者的最佳区域之一，狮子、花豹和猎豹紧随迁徙的角马和斑马群。观赏这一壮观迁移的最佳时间为4月至5月和10月至12月。

Your 7 Days Central Serengeti Safari also takes you through the scenic Ngorongoro Highlands before descending into the spectacular Ngorongoro Crater, a UNESCO World Heritage Site known for its dense wildlife population and one of the best places in Africa to see the Big Five.

El safari también atraviesa las pintorescas tierras altas del Ngorongoro antes de descender al espectacular cráter, Patrimonio Mundial de la UNESCO, conocido por su densa población de fauna y como uno de los mejores lugares de África para ver a los cinco grandes.
行程还将穿越风景秀丽的恩戈罗恩戈罗高地，随后下到壮观的恩戈罗恩戈罗火山口。这处联合国教科文组织世界遗产以野生动物密度高著称，是非洲观赏五霸的最佳地点之一。

After breakfast, drive to Tarangire National Park. Famous for its enormous baobab trees and large elephant populations, the park offers excellent wildlife viewing. Enjoy a full-day game drive spotting lions, giraffes, zebras, buffaloes, antelopes, and diverse birdlife. Tarangire provides a beautiful and less crowded introduction to Tanzania’s safari circuit.

Después del desayuno, trayecto al Parque Nacional de Tarangire. Famoso por sus enormes baobabs y sus grandes poblaciones de elefantes, ofrece una excelente observación de fauna. Safari de día completo para ver leones, jirafas, cebras, búfalos, antílopes y muchas aves. Tarangire es una introducción bonita y poco concurrida al circuito de safaris de Tanzania.

The 6 Days Northern Serengeti safari is a thrilling wildlife adventure designed around the dramatic Mara River Crossing season (July–October). Beginning in Tarangire National Park, you will explore landscapes filled with giant baobab trees and massive elephant herds before continuing to the predator-rich plains of Central Serengeti. This 6 Days Northern Serengeti journey takes you deep into the Seronera area, famous for its lions, cheetahs, and leopards, offering exceptional game viewing and photography opportunities.

El safari de 6 días por el norte del Serengeti es una aventura ideada en torno a la temporada de cruces del río Mara (julio a octubre). Empezando en el Parque Nacional de Tarangire, explorará paisajes de baobabs gigantes y enormes manadas de elefantes antes de continuar a las llanuras del Serengeti central. El viaje se adentra en la zona de Seronera, famosa por sus leones, guepardos y leopardos, con excelentes oportunidades de observación y fotografía.
6天塞伦盖蒂北部之旅是围绕马拉河渡河季（7月至10月）设计的精彩野生动物探险。从塔兰吉雷国家公园开始，探索遍布巨大猴面包树和庞大象群的景观，随后前往捕食者云集的塞伦盖蒂中部平原。行程深入以狮子、猎豹和花豹闻名的塞罗内拉地区，观赏和摄影机会极佳。

Travel north to the iconic Mara River region, where the highlight of the 6 Days Northern Serengeti experience unfolds as thousands of wildebeest and zebras brave crocodile-infested waters during the Great Migration. Spend two full days capturing unforgettable river crossings and dramatic predator-prey interactions before returning to Central Serengeti and descending into the wildlife-rich Ngorongoro Crater. The 6 Days Northern Serengeti safari perfectly combines breathtaking scenery, intense wildlife action, and Africa’s most spectacular natural events.

Viaje al norte, a la emblemática región del río Mara, donde llega el momento culminante: miles de ñus y cebras desafían aguas infestadas de cocodrilos durante la Gran Migración. Pase dos días completos captando cruces inolvidables e intensas escenas entre depredadores y presas antes de volver al Serengeti central y descender al cráter del Ngorongoro. El safari combina paisajes impresionantes, acción salvaje y los acontecimientos naturales más espectaculares de África.
北上前往著名的马拉河地区，迎来行程高潮：大迁徙中成千上万的角马和斑马勇闯鳄鱼出没的河流。用整整两天记录难忘的渡河场面和惊心动魄的捕食瞬间，然后返回塞伦盖蒂中部，下到野生动物丰富的恩戈罗恩戈罗火山口。本行程完美结合壮丽风光、激烈的野生动物场面和非洲最壮观的自然奇景。

Depending on your arrival time, you will have an opportunity to relax after your international journey and enjoy the peaceful atmosphere of this safari town.

抵达乞力马扎罗国际机场或阿鲁沙机场后，公司代表接您送往阿鲁沙住处。视抵达时间，可在长途旅行后休息，享受这座游猎之城的宁静氛围。

After the briefing, enjoy your evening, relax and prepare for the wildlife adventure beginning the following morning.
Después, velada para descansar y preparar la aventura de la mañana siguiente.

Arusha to Tarangire National Park and Mto wa Mbu
De Arusha a Tarangire y Mto wa Mbu
阿鲁沙至塔兰吉雷国家公园与 Mto wa Mbu

After breakfast, depart Arusha and drive towards Tarangire National Park for your first wildlife experience. Famous for its large elephant herds, ancient baobab trees and savannah landscapes, Tarangire offers an excellent introduction to Tanzania's wildlife.
Después del desayuno, salida a Tarangire para su primera experiencia. Famoso por elefantes, baobabs y sabana, es una excelente introducción.
早餐后从阿鲁沙前往塔兰吉雷国家公园开启首次野生动物体验。塔兰吉雷以庞大象群、古老猴面包树和草原风光闻名，是认识坦桑尼亚野生动物的绝佳开篇。

Upon arrival, enjoy a game drive through different areas of the park in search of elephants, lions, giraffes, zebras, wildebeest, buffaloes and numerous bird species. Your guide will share information about the wildlife and the park's ecosystem. Enjoy a picnic lunch inside the park before continuing your afternoon game drive.
Safari en busca de elefantes, leones, jirafas, cebras, ñus, búfalos y aves. Su guía le explicará el ecosistema. Pícnic antes del safari vespertino.
抵达后在园内不同区域游猎，寻找大象、狮子、长颈鹿、斑马、角马、水牛和众多鸟类。向导介绍动物和公园生态。园内野餐后继续下午游猎。

In the late afternoon, exit Tarangire and drive towards Mto wa Mbu, a vibrant town near the Great Rift Valley. Arrive at your accommodation, enjoy dinner and relax after your first day of wildlife exploration.
A última hora, salida hacia Mto wa Mbu, un animado pueblo junto al Gran Valle del Rift. Llegada al alojamiento, cena y descanso.
傍晚离开塔兰吉雷前往东非大裂谷附近的热闹小镇 Mto wa Mbu。抵达住处晚餐，结束首日探索后休息。
Mto wa Mbu to Serengeti National Park: explore the endless plains
De Mto wa Mbu al Serengeti: las llanuras sin fin
Mto wa Mbu 至塞伦盖蒂——探索无垠草原

After an early breakfast, depart Mto wa Mbu and begin your scenic journey towards Serengeti National Park, travelling through the Ngorongoro Conservation Area. Along the way, enjoy views of the volcanic highlands, open grasslands and traditional Maasai communities before reaching the Serengeti ecosystem.
Desayuno temprano y camino panorámico al Serengeti por el Área de Conservación del Ngorongoro, con tierras volcánicas, praderas y comunidades masái.
早早用过早餐，离开 Mto wa Mbu，经恩戈罗恩戈罗保护区沿风景路线前往塞伦盖蒂。途中欣赏火山高地、开阔草原和马赛传统社区。

Upon entering Serengeti, begin your game drive across the endless plains. Search for lions, leopards and cheetahs, alongside elephants, giraffes, zebras and wildebeest. Depending on your travel season, your guide will focus on areas with good opportunities to encounter the Great Wildebeest Migration.
Al entrar, safari por las llanuras en busca de leones, leopardos y guepardos, además de elefantes, jirafas, cebras y ñus. Según la temporada, su guía buscará la Gran Migración.
进入塞伦盖蒂后在无垠草原游猎，寻找狮子、花豹和猎豹，以及大象、长颈鹿、斑马和角马。视季节，向导重点前往容易遇到角马大迁徙的区域。

Enjoy a picnic lunch in the wilderness before continuing your afternoon game drive. Later, proceed to your campsite for dinner and overnight, where you will enjoy an authentic African camping experience surrounded by nature.
Pícnic y safari vespertino. Después, campamento para cenar y dormir en una auténtica experiencia de camping africano.
荒野野餐后继续下午游猎。之后前往营地晚餐住宿，在大自然环抱中享受地道非洲露营。
Full-day game drive in Serengeti: big cats and the Great Migration
Día completo en el Serengeti: felinos y la Gran Migración
塞伦盖蒂全天游猎——大型猫科动物与大迁徙

Wake up early and enjoy breakfast before heading out for a full-day wildlife adventure in Serengeti. This day is dedicated to exploring the plains and searching for the park's big cats, particularly lions, leopards and cheetahs. Serengeti is famous for its predator populations and opportunities to observe wildlife in its natural environment.
Madrugón y desayuno antes de un día completo en busca de leones, leopardos y guepardos. El Serengeti es famoso por sus depredadores.
清早起床用早餐后开启塞伦盖蒂全天探险。这一天专注探索草原、寻找大型猫科动物，尤其是狮子、花豹和猎豹。塞伦盖蒂以捕食者众多、可观察自然状态下的动物而著称。

Explore different areas of the park, including rocky kopjes, open grasslands and riverine habitats where wildlife gathers. Depending on your travel season, your guide will also help you locate the Great Wildebeest Migration, where thousands of wildebeest and zebras move across the ecosystem in search of fresh grazing and water. You may also encounter hyenas, elephants and giraffes.
Explore kopjes, praderas y riberas. Según la temporada, su guía localizará la Gran Migración, con miles de ñus y cebras. También hienas, elefantes y jirafas.
探索花岗岩丘、开阔草原和动物聚集的河岸生境。视季节，向导还会帮您寻找角马大迁徙，成千上万角马和斑马为寻鲜草和水源穿越生态区。还可能遇到鬣狗、大象和长颈鹿。
Enjoy a picnic lunch in the wilderness before continuing your afternoon game drive. In the evening, return to your campsite for dinner and overnight.
Pícnic antes del safari vespertino. Al anochecer, regreso al campamento para cenar y dormir.
荒野野餐后继续下午游猎。傍晚返回营地晚餐住宿。

After breakfast, enjoy a morning game drive in Serengeti as you begin your journey towards the Ngorongoro Conservation Area. This is another opportunity to explore the plains and search for predators before departing the park.
Después del desayuno, safari matinal camino del Área de Conservación del Ngorongoro, otra ocasión de buscar depredadores.
早餐后在塞伦盖蒂晨间游猎，启程前往恩戈罗恩戈罗保护区。离园前再次探索草原、寻找捕食者。

Continue towards the Ngorongoro Highlands, enjoying scenery as the open savannah gradually transforms into rolling hills, volcanic landscapes and lush vegetation. Your guide will share information about the region's wildlife, natural environment and Maasai communities. Enjoy a picnic lunch during the journey before arriving in the Ngorongoro area.
Continúe a las tierras altas, de colinas, paisajes volcánicos y vegetación. Su guía le hablará de la fauna y las comunidades masái. Pícnic por el camino.
继续前往恩戈罗恩戈罗高地，开阔草原渐变为起伏丘陵、火山地貌和茂盛植被。向导介绍当地动物、自然环境和马赛社区。途中野餐后抵达恩戈罗恩戈罗地区。

In the afternoon, arrive at your campsite in the Ngorongoro Highlands, settle in and enjoy a freshly prepared dinner from your safari cook. Relax and prepare for the following day's Ngorongoro Crater experience, one of the highlights of your safari.
Por la tarde, llegada al campamento, cena de su cocinero y descanso antes del cráter, uno de los momentos culminantes.
下午抵达恩戈罗恩戈罗高地营地，安顿后享用厨师现做的晚餐。休息备战次日火山口之旅——本次游猎的亮点之一。
Ngorongoro Crater game drive and overnight at Fanaka Lodge
Safari en el cráter y noche en Fanaka Lodge
恩戈罗恩戈罗火山口游猎与 Fanaka Lodge 住宿

After an early breakfast, depart for the spectacular Ngorongoro Crater. Descend approximately 600 metres into the crater for a game drive across its landscape. The crater is home to an extraordinary concentration of wildlife.
Tras un desayuno temprano, descenso de unos 600 metros al cráter, hogar de una extraordinaria concentración de fauna.
早早用过早餐，前往壮观的恩戈罗恩戈罗火山口。下降约600米进入火山口游猎，这里野生动物密度惊人。

Explore the crater floor in search of the African Big Five, including lions, elephants, buffaloes, leopards and the endangered black rhino. You may also encounter zebras, wildebeest, hippos, hyenas and numerous bird species. Enjoy a picnic lunch at a designated picnic site.
Busque a los cinco grandes: leones, elefantes, búfalos, leopardos y rinoceronte negro, además de cebras, ñus, hipopótamos, hienas y aves. Pícnic en una zona habilitada.
在火山口底寻找非洲五霸：狮子、大象、水牛、花豹和濒危黑犀牛。还可能看到斑马、角马、河马、鬣狗和众多鸟类。在指定野餐点用午餐。

In the afternoon, ascend the crater walls and drive towards Mto wa Mbu. Arrive at Fanaka Lodge, where you can enjoy a private room, freshen up and relax after an exciting day. Enjoy dinner and overnight at the lodge.
Por la tarde, subida y camino a Mto wa Mbu. En Fanaka Lodge tendrá habitación privada para asearse y descansar. Cena y noche.
下午驶出火山口前往 Mto wa Mbu。抵达 Fanaka Lodge，入住独立房间，梳洗休息。在酒店晚餐住宿。
Lake Manyara National Park and departure
Parque del Lago Manyara y salida
马尼亚拉湖国家公园与离境

After breakfast, depart for Lake Manyara National Park for your final wildlife experience. Located beneath the Great Rift Valley escarpment, this park offers groundwater forests, open grasslands and lakeside landscapes. It is particularly famous for its birdlife, elephants, baboons and tree-climbing lions.
Después del desayuno, salida al lago Manyara, bajo el escarpe del Rift, con bosques de aguas subterráneas, praderas y orillas. Famoso por aves, elefantes, babuinos y leones trepadores.
早餐后前往马尼亚拉湖国家公园进行最后的野生动物体验。公园位于东非大裂谷崖壁之下，有地下水森林、开阔草原和湖滨风光，尤以鸟类、大象、狒狒和爬树狮子闻名。

Enjoy a game drive through the park in search of elephants, giraffes, zebras, buffaloes, hippos and other wildlife. Keep an eye out for the tree-climbing lions and the colourful bird species around the lake. Enjoy a picnic lunch during your exploration.
Safari en busca de elefantes, jirafas, cebras, búfalos e hipopótamos. Atento a los leones trepadores y las aves. Pícnic durante el recorrido.
在园内游猎寻找大象、长颈鹿、斑马、水牛、河马等。留意爬树狮子和湖周缤纷鸟类。途中野餐午餐。

In the afternoon, exit Lake Manyara National Park and begin your journey towards Arusha, Kilimanjaro International Airport or Arusha Airport, depending on your departure arrangements. Our driver will ensure a comfortable transfer according to your flight schedule.
Por la tarde, camino a Arusha o al aeropuerto según su salida. Nuestro conductor le llevará a tiempo para su vuelo.
下午离开马尼亚拉湖国家公园，按离境安排前往阿鲁沙、乞力马扎罗国际机场或阿鲁沙机场。司机根据航班时间安排舒适接送。

In the evening, meet your safari consultant for a detailed safari briefing. You will review your itinerary, discuss the wildlife experiences ahead, and meet your professional safari guide, who will accompany you throughout the journey.
Por la noche, briefing con su asesor, repaso del itinerario y presentación de su guía.
晚上与游猎顾问会面听取详细说明，核对行程、了解野生动物体验，并认识全程陪同的专业向导。
Budget accommodation in Arusha
Alojamiento económico en Arusha
阿鲁沙经济型住宿

After breakfast, depart Arusha and drive towards Tarangire National Park for your first wildlife experience. Famous for its elephant populations, ancient baobab trees and savannah landscapes, Tarangire offers an excellent introduction to Tanzania's wildlife.
Después del desayuno, salida a Tarangire. Famoso por sus elefantes, baobabs y sabana, es una excelente introducción.
早餐后从阿鲁沙前往塔兰吉雷国家公园开启首次野生动物体验。塔兰吉雷以象群、古老猴面包树和草原风光闻名，是认识坦桑尼亚野生动物的绝佳开篇。

Enjoy an extensive game drive through different wildlife areas in search of elephants, lions, giraffes, zebras, wildebeest, buffaloes and numerous bird species. Your guide will help you understand the park's ecosystem while identifying wildlife and explaining animal behaviour. Enjoy a picnic lunch inside the park before continuing your afternoon game drive.
Largo safari en busca de elefantes, leones, jirafas, cebras, ñus, búfalos y aves. Su guía le explicará el ecosistema y el comportamiento. Pícnic antes del safari vespertino.
在不同区域长时间游猎，寻找大象、狮子、长颈鹿、斑马、角马、水牛和众多鸟类。向导帮您了解公园生态，辨识动物并讲解行为。园内野餐后继续下午游猎。

In the late afternoon, exit Tarangire and drive towards Mto wa Mbu, a vibrant town near the Great Rift Valley. Arrive at your campsite, where your safari cook will prepare dinner. Relax and enjoy your first night of camping.
A última hora, camino a Mto wa Mbu, cerca del Gran Valle del Rift. En el campamento, su cocinero preparará la cena. Primera noche de camping.
傍晚离开塔兰吉雷前往东非大裂谷附近的热闹小镇 Mto wa Mbu。抵达营地后厨师准备晚餐，放松享受首个露营之夜。
Public or designated campsite in Mto wa Mbu
Camping público o designado en Mto wa Mbu
Mto wa Mbu 公共或指定营地

After an early breakfast, depart Mto wa Mbu and begin your scenic journey towards Serengeti National Park. Travel through the Ngorongoro Conservation Area, enjoying highland landscapes, volcanic scenery and opportunities to observe traditional Maasai communities along the way.
Desayuno temprano y camino panorámico al Serengeti por el Área de Conservación del Ngorongoro, con tierras altas, paisajes volcánicos y comunidades masái.
早早用过早餐，离开 Mto wa Mbu 沿风景路线前往塞伦盖蒂。穿越恩戈罗恩戈罗保护区，欣赏高地风光、火山景观，沿途可见马赛传统社区。

As you approach Serengeti, the scenery gradually transforms into endless golden savannah plains dotted with acacia trees and rocky kopjes. Upon entering the park, begin your game drive in search of lions, elephants, giraffes, zebras, wildebeest and other wildlife.
El paisaje se transforma en sabana dorada con acacias y kopjes. Al entrar, safari en busca de leones, elefantes, jirafas, cebras y ñus.
接近塞伦盖蒂时，景色渐变为点缀金合欢树和花岗岩丘的无垠金色稀树草原。入园后开始游猎，寻找狮子、大象、长颈鹿、斑马、角马等。

Enjoy a picnic lunch during your journey before continuing with your afternoon game drive. Depending on the season, your guide will select suitable wildlife-viewing areas, with particular attention to the Great Wildebeest Migration and its predators. In the evening, proceed to your campsite for dinner and overnight.
Pícnic y safari vespertino, con atención a la Gran Migración y sus depredadores según la temporada. Al anochecer, campamento.
途中野餐后继续下午游猎。视季节，向导选择合适的观赏区域，特别关注角马大迁徙及其捕食者。傍晚前往营地晚餐住宿。
Public campsite in Serengeti National Park
Camping público en el Parque Nacional del Serengeti
塞伦盖蒂国家公园公共营地
Full-day game drive in Serengeti: discover the big cats
Día completo en el Serengeti: los grandes felinos
塞伦盖蒂全天游猎——发现大型猫科动物

Wake up early and enjoy breakfast before heading out for a full-day wildlife adventure in Serengeti. This day is dedicated to exploring the plains and searching for some of Africa's most fascinating predators, especially lions, leopards and cheetahs. Serengeti is internationally recognised for its big-cat populations.
Madrugón y desayuno antes de un día completo en busca de los depredadores más fascinantes: leones, leopardos y guepardos.
清早起床用早餐后开启塞伦盖蒂全天探险。这一天专注寻找非洲最迷人的捕食者，尤其是狮子、花豹和猎豹。塞伦盖蒂的大型猫科动物数量举世公认。

Explore different areas of the park, including open grasslands, rocky kopjes and riverine habitats where wildlife gathers. Keep your eyes open for lions resting beneath trees, leopards in acacia branches and cheetahs scanning the open plains for prey. Your guide will use their knowledge and experience to help you find these animals.
Explore praderas, kopjes y riberas. Atento a leones bajo los árboles, leopardos en las acacias y guepardos oteando presas. Su guía le ayudará a encontrarlos.
探索开阔草原、花岗岩丘和动物聚集的河岸生境。留意树下休憩的狮子、金合欢枝头的花豹和眺望猎物的猎豹。向导凭经验帮您寻找它们。

Enjoy a picnic lunch in the wilderness before continuing your afternoon game drive. Take time to appreciate the landscapes, capture photographs and observe wildlife in its natural environment. In the evening, return to your campsite for dinner and another night in the wilderness.
Pícnic antes del safari vespertino para disfrutar de paisajes y fotos. Al anochecer, regreso al campamento.
荒野野餐后继续下午游猎。从容欣赏风光、拍照、观察自然状态下的动物。傍晚返回营地晚餐，再度荒野过夜。
Full-day Serengeti: follow the Great Wildebeest Migration
Serengeti, día completo: tras la Gran Migración
塞伦盖蒂全天——追随角马大迁徙

Today offers another opportunity to explore Serengeti and experience one of the world's greatest wildlife spectacles: the Great Wildebeest Migration. After breakfast, depart with your picnic lunch for a full-day game drive, following the seasonal movements of wildebeest and zebras as they travel across the Serengeti ecosystem in search of fresh grazing and water.
Hoy, otra ocasión de vivir uno de los mayores espectáculos del mundo: la Gran Migración. Con pícnic, safari de día completo siguiendo a ñus y cebras en busca de pastos y agua.
今天再次探索塞伦盖蒂，体验世界最伟大的野生动物奇观之一——角马大迁徙。早餐后带上野餐出发全天游猎，按季节动向追随为寻鲜草和水源穿越生态区的角马和斑马。

Depending on your travel season, your guide will select the most suitable migration areas. These may include the southern plains of Ndutu during the calving season, the western corridor around the Grumeti River, the central Serengeti, or the northern Serengeti near the Mara River crossings. You may also encounter predators such as lions, leopards, cheetahs and hyenas following the herds.
Según la temporada, su guía elegirá las mejores zonas: Ndutu en los partos, el corredor occidental del Grumeti, el centro o el norte junto al Mara, con posibles depredadores tras las manadas.
视出行季节，向导选择最合适的迁徙区域：产仔季的恩杜图南部平原、格鲁梅蒂河一带的西部走廊、塞伦盖蒂中部，或马拉河渡河点附近的北部。还可能遇到尾随兽群的狮子、花豹、猎豹和鬣狗。
Enjoy a picnic lunch in the wilderness before continuing your wildlife exploration throughout the afternoon. Later, return to your campsite for dinner and overnight.
Pícnic y más safari por la tarde. Después, regreso al campamento para cenar y dormir.
荒野野餐后下午继续探索。之后返回营地晚餐住宿。

Enjoy breakfast at the campsite before beginning your journey from Serengeti towards the Ngorongoro Conservation Area. Depending on wildlife activity and your departure time, enjoy a morning game drive as you make your way out of Serengeti, with another opportunity to encounter wildlife.
Desayuno en el campamento y salida del Serengeti hacia el Ngorongoro, con safari matinal si el horario lo permite.
在营地用早餐后离开塞伦盖蒂前往恩戈罗恩戈罗保护区。视动物活动和出发时间，出园途中进行晨间游猎，再添邂逅机会。

Continue towards the Ngorongoro Highlands, passing through scenery where open grasslands give way to rolling hills, volcanic landscapes and lush highland vegetation. Along the way, learn about the relationship between wildlife, local communities and the surrounding conservation areas.
Camino a las tierras altas, de colinas volcánicas y vegetación. Aprenda sobre la relación entre fauna, comunidades y áreas protegidas.
继续前往恩戈罗恩戈罗高地，开阔草原渐变为起伏丘陵、火山景观和葱郁高地植被。途中了解野生动物、当地社区与周边保护区的关系。

Arrive at your campsite in the Ngorongoro Highlands during the afternoon. Settle in, enjoy a freshly prepared dinner from your safari cook, and relax in preparation for the following day's crater experience. An early night is recommended.
Llegada al campamento por la tarde, cena de su cocinero y descanso. Conviene acostarse temprano.
下午抵达恩戈罗恩戈罗高地营地。安顿后享用厨师现做的晚餐，休息备战次日火山口体验。建议早睡。

Explore the crater floor in search of the African Big Five, including elephants, lions, buffaloes, leopards and the endangered black rhino. You may also encounter zebras, wildebeest, hippos, hyenas and numerous bird species. Enjoy a picnic lunch at a designated picnic site before continuing your exploration of the crater's grasslands, woodlands, swamps and lakes.
Busque a los cinco grandes, además de cebras, ñus, hipopótamos, hienas y aves. Pícnic antes de seguir por praderas, bosques, pantanos y lagos.
在火山口底寻找非洲五霸：大象、狮子、水牛、花豹和濒危黑犀牛。还可能看到斑马、角马、河马、鬣狗和众多鸟类。在指定点野餐后继续探索草原、林地、沼泽和湖泊。
In the afternoon, ascend the crater walls and begin your journey back to Arusha. Check in at your accommodation, enjoy dinner and relax after an exciting day.
Por la tarde, subida y regreso a Arusha. Alojamiento, cena y descanso.
下午驶出火山口返回阿鲁沙。入住住处，晚餐休息，结束精彩一天。

Kilimanjaro National Park Day Excursion often called the “Sneak Peek of the Peak Hike,” is a perfect way to experience the beauty of Africa’s highest mountain in just one day. Starting along the scenic Marangu Route in Kilimanjaro National Park, you’ll walk through lush rainforest filled with fresh mountain air, giant trees, and playful wildlife such as blue monkeys, colobus monkeys, and colorful birds. On clear days, you may even catch a stunning glimpse of the snow-capped summit of Mount Kilimanjaro rising above the clouds.

La excursión de un día al Parque Nacional del Kilimanjaro, a menudo llamada «un adelanto de la cumbre», es una forma perfecta de vivir en un solo día la belleza de la montaña más alta de África. Comenzando por la pintoresca ruta Marangu, caminará por una exuberante selva de aire fresco, árboles gigantes y fauna juguetona, como monos azules, colobos y aves de colores. En días despejados puede vislumbrar la cumbre nevada del Kilimanjaro sobre las nubes.
乞力马扎罗国家公园一日游常被称为“登顶前的初体验”，让您在一天内领略非洲最高峰之美。从风景秀丽的马兰古路线出发，穿行于空气清新的茂密雨林，沿途有参天大树和活泼的青猴、疣猴及缤纷鸟类。天气晴朗时，还能望见云层之上白雪覆盖的乞力马扎罗峰顶。

This guided trek is led by local experts who share stories about the mountain and the traditions of the Chagga people, giving you a deeper cultural connection to the area. It’s an easy and rewarding hike suitable for families and casual travelers, offering a mix of nature, culture, and breathtaking scenery—all in one unforgettable day experience.

El recorrido lo dirigen expertos locales que cuentan historias de la montaña y las tradiciones del pueblo chagga, para una conexión cultural más profunda. Es una caminata fácil y gratificante, apta para familias y viajeros ocasionales, que combina naturaleza, cultura y paisajes impresionantes en un día inolvidable.
本地资深向导带队，讲述山的故事和查加族的传统，让您与当地文化建立更深联系。这是一段轻松而收获满满的徒步，适合家庭和休闲旅客，自然、文化与壮丽风光尽在难忘的一天。

You will be picked up from your hotel in Arusha and transferred to the Marangu Gate of the National Park (approx. 30-40 min drive). For the day excursion you will effectively be doing the first day of the total climb- through the lush rainforest ecosystem. From the Marangu gate, accompanied by your professional mountain guide, you will hike to the Mandara Huts, at an altitude of 2700m. You will stop here for lunch and then take a short walk to view the Maundi crater, from where you can see the view of both the Mawenzi peak and Kibo peak (the summit).

Le recogeremos en su hotel de Arusha para llevarle a la puerta Marangu del parque (unos 30-40 minutos en coche). En la excursión hará en la práctica el primer día del ascenso completo, a través de la exuberante selva. Desde la puerta Marangu, con su guía de montaña profesional, caminará hasta las cabañas Mandara, a 2700 m de altitud. Allí almorzará y después dará un breve paseo hasta el cráter Maundi, desde donde se ven el pico Mawenzi y el pico Kibo (la cumbre).
我们将在阿鲁沙酒店接您，前往国家公园马兰古大门（车程约30至40分钟）。一日游实际上走的是完整登山行程的第一天，穿越茂密的雨林生态系统。从马兰古大门出发，在专业登山向导陪同下徒步至海拔2700米的曼达拉营地。在此用午餐后，短途步行至毛恩迪火山口，可眺望马文济峰和基博峰（主峰）。

Ngorongoro Crater Day Excursion offers an unforgettable safari experience in the iconic Ngorongoro Crater, a UNESCO World Heritage Site often called “Africa’s Garden of Eden.” Within this विशाल, intact volcanic caldera, over 25,000 animals roam freely, giving you an excellent chance to spot the Big Five—lion, elephant, buffalo, leopard, and the rare black rhino—all in a single day. The crater’s compact landscape means more wildlife viewing and less driving, making every moment count.

La excursión de un día al cráter del Ngorongoro ofrece un safari inolvidable en este lugar emblemático, Patrimonio Mundial de la UNESCO, a menudo llamado «el jardín del Edén de África». En esta vasta caldera volcánica intacta viven en libertad más de 25,000 animales, con una excelente oportunidad de ver a los cinco grandes (león, elefante, búfalo, leopardo y el raro rinoceronte negro) en un solo día. Lo compacto del cráter significa más observación y menos conducción.

<a1>Lake Ndutu Luxury Tented Lodge</a1>

Lake Ndutu Luxury Tented Lodge is located within the Ngorongoro Conservation Area, in the southeastern plains of the Serengeti ecosystem, some 5 kilometres or 15 minutes drive from Ndutu airstrip, and about 300 kilometres or 5 hours drive / 1 hour flight from Arusha town. Ndutu is the only place in the Serengeti ecosystem where migratory animals - wildebeest and zebras - roam for more than 5 months, attracting a high concentration and variety of predators. It is the main holding ground, with the short grass plains in Ndutu and southeastern Serengeti providing the necessary calving grounds for zebras and wildebeest, which usually give birth to thousands of calves and foals between January and March. The lodge is also conveniently situated close to the prime game viewing areas of Seronera valley in the central Serengeti about 80kms (1 ½ hours drive), nearby Kusini and Moru in southern Serengeti, and the world famous Ngorongoro Crater 90kms (2 hours drive) to the east.

Lake Ndutu Luxury Tented Lodge está en el Área de Conservación del Ngorongoro, en las llanuras del sureste del ecosistema del Serengeti, a unos 5 km o 15 minutos de la pista de Ndutu y a unos 300 km (5 horas por carretera o 1 hora de vuelo) de Arusha. Ndutu es el único lugar del ecosistema donde los ñus y cebras migratorios permanecen más de 5 meses, lo que atrae gran concentración y variedad de depredadores. Sus praderas de hierba corta son las zonas de parto, con miles de crías entre enero y marzo. El lodge está bien situado respecto al valle de Seronera, a unos 80 km (1 hora y media), las zonas de Kusini y Moru y el cráter del Ngorongoro, a 90 km (2 horas) al este.

Lake Ndutu Luxury Tented Lodge 位于恩戈罗恩戈罗保护区内、塞伦盖蒂生态系统东南部平原，距恩杜图简易机场约5公里（车程15分钟），距阿鲁沙约300公里（车程5小时或飞行1小时）。恩杜图是塞伦盖蒂生态系统中唯一一处迁徙角马和斑马停留超过5个月的地方，吸引了大量且多样的捕食者。恩杜图和塞伦盖蒂东南部的矮草平原是兽群的主要聚集地和产仔场，每年1月至3月有成千上万幼崽出生。酒店交通便利：距塞伦盖蒂中部塞罗内拉河谷黄金观赏区约80公里（1.5小时车程），邻近南部的库西尼和莫鲁，东距举世闻名的恩戈罗恩戈罗火山口90公里（2小时车程）。

<a1>Sanctuary Kusini</a1>

Built around a spectacular rocky outcrop and on the path of the wildebeest migration, Sanctuary Kusini is located in the quiet southern region of the Serengeti, some 30 – 45 minutes-drive from Serengeti South Airstrip. Sanctuary Kusini offers twelve spacious double tents scattered around the main kopje, each has en-suite facilities with an indoor shower. Large private decking with comfortable furnishings extends in front of each tent, with views of the surrounding bush below where zebra, buffalo and lion are a common sight year-round. The tented rooms feature mosquito netting, hairdryers and in-room safe. Guests also have a personal tent attendant to look after their every need during their stay. The dining area, lounge and library are housed in the main area, which affords spectacular views from its wooden deck and the adjacent kopje. The camp also has a bush boutique for curio shop purchases. Complimentary wireless internet access is available in the rooms. Electricity supply is a combination of silent packed generator and battery system.

Construido en torno a un espectacular afloramiento rocoso y en la ruta de la migración, Sanctuary Kusini está en el tranquilo sur del Serengeti, a unos 30-45 minutos de la pista Serengeti South. Ofrece doce amplias tiendas dobles alrededor del kopje principal, con baño privado y ducha interior, y una gran terraza con vistas a cebras, búfalos y leones todo el año. Las tiendas tienen mosquiteras, secador y caja fuerte, y cada huésped cuenta con un asistente personal. El área principal alberga comedor, salón y biblioteca con vistas desde la terraza de madera. Hay boutique de recuerdos, internet inalámbrico gratuito en las habitaciones y electricidad por generador silencioso y baterías.

Sanctuary Kusini 环绕一处壮观的岩石露头而建，正处角马迁徙路线上，位于塞伦盖蒂宁静的南部，距 Serengeti South 简易机场约30至45分钟车程。营地有12顶宽敞双人帐篷散布于主岩丘周围，均带室内淋浴的独立卫浴。每顶帐篷前设有配舒适家具的大型私人露台，可俯瞰下方灌丛，全年常见斑马、水牛和狮子。帐篷内配蚊帐、吹风机和保险箱，并配有专属帐篷服务员。主区设餐厅、休息室和图书室，木质露台和邻近岩丘视野绝佳。营地设有纪念品小店，客房提供免费无线网络，由静音发电机和电池系统供电。

Ndutu Safari Lodge is situated in the Ngorongoro Conservation Area in the south eastern part of the Serengeti ecosystem, about 30km to Naabi entry gate to Serengeti National Park, one kilometre from Ndutu airstrip and about 280km drive from Arusha town. Nestling under a canopy of tall acacia trees, each of the 34 en suite cottages, which are built of local material, has a private verandah facing Lake Ndutu. Ten rooms have a double bed, 18 are twin rooms with single beds, five are triple rooms, and there is a family room which can accommodate 2 adults and 2 children, all accessible with wheelchair. Ndutu Camp which now features comfortable cottages still has the informal, intimate feeling of the original bush tented camp built in the 1960s by George Dove. The main and central building houses an open-sided bar, lounge and dining room. Other facilities include laundry, internet access, telephone & fax services, curio/gift shop, a campfire, and walking safari with an armed ranger arranged directly with NCAA ranger post less than a kilometre away from the lodge.

Bajo altas acacias, sus 34 cabañas con baño, de materiales locales, tienen terraza privada frente al lago Ndutu: diez con cama doble, 18 con camas individuales, cinco triples y una familiar para 2 adultos y 2 niños, todas accesibles en silla de ruedas. Conserva el ambiente íntimo del campamento original construido en los años sesenta por George Dove. El edificio principal tiene bar, salón y comedor abiertos. Además: lavandería, internet, teléfono y fax, tienda de recuerdos, hoguera y safaris a pie con guardaparques armado.

Tarangire Safari Lodge is located inside the Park, on top of a high bluff with a panoramic view of Tarangire River below, about 7 km from the Tarangire National Park main gate, and approximately 2 hours drive (120 km) from Arusha town. Tarangire Safari Lodge has a total of 40 guest rooms made up of 24 twin and 11 double tents built on a solid base with thatched roof and verandah, and 5 bungalows for triple occupancy built from local stone in the circular style of Maasai huts, all with en suite bathroom (shower, solar-heated water), and a verandah. The lodge boasts a spacious open-air dining room, serving international home-style safari cuisine; coffee and Tea is complimentary all day long. The lodge serves an early dinner for young children and the chefs can cater for any dietary requirements. Other facilities include a well stocked bar and lounge, an outdoor pool, a splash pool for children, laundry, and a gift shop. WiFi is available in the main lounge and charges are applicable.

Sanctuary Swala is located in a secluded area of the Tarangire National Park, famed for its baobab trees and herds of elephants, about 70km from the main gate, 185km or four hours-drive from Arusha town , and 45 minutes-drive from Kuro Airstrip. Sanctuary Swala offers 12 luxurious open-plan and spacious canvas tents; all shaded by acacia trees and within site of the waterhole frequented by elephants and big cats. Each tent has an en-suite bathroom with indoor and outdoor shower and features a spacious open plan arrangement with comfortable king or twin beds and relaxing chairs. Children of 6 years and older are welcome at the camp, children aged 15 years and younger are required to share with their parents. Two triples are available on request. A hair dryer, ceiling fan, in-room safe, mosquito nets and private deck are available in all tents. Each tent has a personal attendant to attend to guests’ needs. Complimentary Wi-Fi is available in all guest tents.

Lake Manyara Tree Lodge is located inside Lake Manyara National Park on the southern border of the park, nestled in the mahogany forest blending well into the natural beauty of its breathtaking surroundings, about a kilometer from the lakeshore, and 150 km from Arusha town. Mkomazi National Park is a remote and lesser-known safari destination located in northern Tanzania along the Kenya border. Characterized by vast semi-arid savannahs, acacia woodlands, and dramatic mountain backdrops, the park offers a raw and unspoiled wilderness experience far from the busy safari circuits. Its quiet atmosphere and wide-open landscapes make it ideal for travelers seeking solitude, adventure, and authentic African scenery.

Mkomazi es un destino remoto y poco conocido en el norte, junto a Kenia. Con vastas sabanas semiáridas, bosques de acacias y montañas al fondo, ofrece una naturaleza virgen lejos de los circuitos concurridos. Su tranquilidad lo hace ideal para quien busca soledad, aventura y paisajes africanos auténticos.
姆科马齐国家公园位于坦桑尼亚北部与肯尼亚边境，是一处偏远且鲜为人知的游猎目的地。辽阔的半干旱稀树草原、金合欢林地和壮丽的山峦背景，呈现远离热门游猎线路的原始荒野。宁静的氛围和开阔风景，非常适合追求清静、探险和地道非洲风光的旅行者。

The park is especially important for conservation, as it protects endangered species such as black rhinos, African wild dogs, and the rare Grevy’s zebra. Game drives and guided walking safaris provide excellent opportunities to observe wildlife in a natural, uncrowded environment. Mkomazi also borders Maasai communities, allowing visitors to gain cultural insights and learn about traditional lifestyles, adding a meaningful cultural dimension to the safari experience.

El parque es clave para la conservación: protege especies amenazadas como el rinoceronte negro, el licaón y la rara cebra de Grévy. Recorridos y safaris a pie guiados permiten observar la fauna sin multitudes. Limita con comunidades masái, lo que aporta una dimensión cultural.
公园在保护方面尤为重要，守护着黑犀牛、非洲野犬和珍稀的格氏斑马等濒危物种。驱车游猎和向导徒步让您在自然清静的环境中观赏动物。姆科马齐还与马赛社区接壤，游客可了解传统生活方式，为游猎增添有意义的文化内涵。

Kilimanjaro National Park, located in northern Tanzania, is home to Mount Kilimanjaro, Africa’s highest peak at 5,895 meters. The park protects an extraordinary range of landscapes, from lush tropical rainforests and alpine meadows to the iconic snow-capped summit. This dramatic change in ecosystems makes Kilimanjaro one of the most unique natural areas in Africa and a top destination for trekking, adventure travel, and nature lovers.

El parque, en el norte de Tanzania, alberga el Kilimanjaro, el pico más alto de África (5,895 m). Protege una extraordinaria variedad de paisajes, de selvas y praderas alpinas a la cumbre nevada. Este cambio de ecosistemas lo convierte en un espacio único y un destino destacado para el trekking y la naturaleza.
乞力马扎罗国家公园位于坦桑尼亚北部，拥有海拔5,895米的非洲最高峰乞力马扎罗山。公园保护着极为丰富的景观，从葱郁热带雨林、高山草甸到标志性的雪顶峰顶。生态系统的剧烈变化使乞力马扎罗成为非洲最独特的自然区域之一，也是徒步、探险和自然爱好者的首选目的地。

Beyond its legendary summit, the park also offers rich biodiversity in its lower forest zones, where visitors can encounter elephants, buffalo, monkeys, and a wide variety of bird species. As a UNESCO World Heritage Site, Kilimanjaro National Park is not only a symbol of natural beauty and adventure but also a must-visit destination for travelers seeking an unforgettable African experience.
Además de su cumbre, ofrece biodiversidad en los bosques bajos, con elefantes, búfalos, monos y muchas aves. Patrimonio de la UNESCO, es símbolo de belleza y aventura y visita imprescindible.
除传奇峰顶外，公园低海拔森林生物多样性丰富，游客可遇到大象、水牛、猴子和种类繁多的鸟类。作为联合国教科文组织世界遗产，乞力马扎罗国家公园不仅是自然之美与探险的象征，更是追求难忘非洲体验者必到之地。

Udzungwa Mountains National Park is renowned for its breathtaking tropical rainforest, scenic hiking trails, and spectacular waterfalls, including the Sanje Waterfalls, among Tanzania’s highest and most picturesque. Unlike traditional safari parks, Udzungwa offers walking safaris, nature treks, and mountain hiking, allowing visitors to immerse themselves in untouched forests, winding rivers, and deep valleys while taking in stunning natural landscapes.

Udzungwa es célebre por su selva tropical, senderos y cascadas, como las de Sanje, de las más altas y pintorescas de Tanzania. A diferencia de los parques de safari tradicionales, ofrece safaris a pie, caminatas y senderismo de montaña entre bosques intactos, ríos y valles profundos.
乌宗瓦山国家公园以壮丽的热带雨林、风景步道和壮观瀑布闻名，其中 Sanje 瀑布是坦桑尼亚最高、最秀美的瀑布之一。与传统游猎公园不同，这里提供徒步游猎、自然徒步和登山，让您沉浸于原始森林、蜿蜒河流和深谷之中。

The park is a sanctuary for unique and rare wildlife, including endemic species such as the Udzungwa red colobus monkey and the Sanje mangabey. With over 400 bird species, diverse butterflies, and rich plant life, Udzungwa is a top destination for birdwatching, wildlife photography, and eco-friendly travel. Its cool climate, serene environment, and unspoiled nature make it perfect for adventure seekers, hikers, and anyone looking to experience a true African rainforest adventure.

Es un santuario de especies raras, como el colobo rojo de Udzungwa y el mangabey de Sanje. Con más de 400 aves, mariposas y rica flora, destaca para la observación de aves, la fotografía y el turismo ecológico. Su clima fresco y naturaleza virgen lo hacen perfecto para aventureros y senderistas.

Mikumi National Park is one of Tanzania’s most rewarding and easily accessible safari destinations, located near Morogoro in the southern part of the country. Covering more than 3,200 square kilometers, the park is dominated by wide open savannahs, acacia woodlands, and riverine forests that create ideal habitats for a rich variety of wildlife. Often compared to a smaller and more intimate Serengeti, Mikumi offers excellent chances to see lions, elephants, giraffes, zebras, wildebeests, buffalo, and many other species roaming freely across the plains.

Mikumi es uno de los destinos de safari más gratificantes y accesibles, cerca de Morogoro. Con más de 3,200 km², dominan sabanas abiertas, acacias y bosques de ribera, hábitat ideal para mucha fauna. Comparado a menudo con un Serengeti más pequeño e íntimo, permite ver leones, elefantes, jirafas, cebras, ñus, búfalos y más.
米库米国家公园是坦桑尼亚收获最丰、最易抵达的游猎目的地之一，位于该国南部莫罗戈罗附近。面积超过3,200平方公里，以开阔稀树草原、金合欢林和河岸森林为主，是多样野生动物的理想栖息地。常被比作更小巧亲切的塞伦盖蒂，极有机会看到狮子、大象、长颈鹿、斑马、角马、水牛等自由漫步于平原。

At the heart of the park lies the fertile Mkata Floodplain, a magnet for large herds of herbivores and the predators that follow them, making wildlife sightings frequent and exciting throughout the year. Game drives provide classic safari experiences with fewer vehicles, allowing visitors to enjoy uninterrupted views and peaceful encounters with nature. Guided walking safaris offer a deeper connection to the landscape, revealing the park’s plants, tracks, and smaller wildlife often missed on game drives.

En su corazón está la fértil llanura del Mkata, imán de grandes manadas y depredadores, con avistamientos frecuentes todo el año. Los recorridos ofrecen safari clásico con menos vehículos, y los safaris a pie guiados revelan plantas, huellas y animales pequeños.
公园腹地是肥沃的 Mkata 泛滥平原，吸引大群食草动物及尾随的捕食者，全年观赏机会频繁精彩。驱车游猎体验经典而车辆稀少，视野不受打扰，与自然宁静相处。向导徒步游猎让您与土地更亲近，发现驱车时常错过的植物、足迹和小动物。

Mikumi is also a paradise for bird lovers, with over 400 bird species recorded in its forests, rivers, and wetlands. Thanks to its close proximity to Dar es Salaam, the park is ideal for short safaris, weekend escapes, or as part of a longer southern Tanzania itinerary. With a range of lodges and camps to suit different budgets, Mikumi National Park combines convenience, biodiversity, and tranquility, making it a must-visit destination for travelers seeking an authentic and relaxed Tanzanian safari experience.

Es un paraíso para los amantes de las aves, con más de 400 especies. Por su cercanía a Dar es Salaam, es ideal para safaris cortos, escapadas o como parte de un itinerario más largo por el sur, con lodges y campamentos para varios presupuestos.
米库米也是观鸟者的天堂，在其森林、河流和湿地记录到400多种鸟类。因靠近达累斯萨拉姆，非常适合短途游猎、周末度假，或纳入更长的南部行程。各种预算的酒店营地齐全，便利、生物多样性与宁静兼备，是追求地道轻松游猎者的必访之地。

Nyerere National Park is Tanzania’s largest and one of Africa’s most spectacular wilderness areas, offering an authentic safari experience far from the crowds. Located in the southern circuit, the park was formerly part of the Selous Game Reserve and spans vast savannahs, woodlands, wetlands, rivers, and lakes. The mighty Rufiji River flows through the park, sustaining abundant wildlife and creating dramatic landscapes that are perfect for exploration, photography, and nature appreciation.

Nyerere, el mayor parque de Tanzania, ofrece un safari auténtico lejos de las multitudes. En el circuito sur, formaba parte de la Reserva de Selous y abarca sabanas, bosques, humedales, ríos y lagos. El poderoso Rufiji lo atraviesa, sostiene abundante fauna y crea paisajes ideales para explorar y fotografiar.
尼雷尔国家公园是坦桑尼亚最大、非洲最壮观的荒野之一，远离人群，提供地道游猎体验。公园位于南部环线，原属塞卢斯野生动物保护区，涵盖辽阔草原、林地、湿地、河流和湖泊。浩荡的鲁菲吉河穿园而过，养育丰富动物，造就适合探索、摄影和赏景的壮丽风光。

The park is renowned for its diverse and abundant wildlife, including elephants, lions, leopards, buffaloes, giraffes, hippos, crocodiles, and the rare African wild dog. Its remote location and vast, open spaces allow for uninterrupted wildlife encounters, making every safari a memorable adventure. Visitors can enjoy classic game drives, walking safaris, and boat safaris along the Rufiji River, all set within a pristine, largely untouched ecosystem. With its combination of wilderness, biodiversity, and fewer visitors, Nyerere National Park offers an exclusive and adventurous African safari experience.

Es célebre por su fauna: elefantes, leones, leopardos, búfalos, jirafas, hipopótamos, cocodrilos y el raro licaón. Ofrece recorridos, safaris a pie y en barca por el Rufiji en un ecosistema casi intacto, para una experiencia exclusiva y aventurera.
公园以丰富多样的动物闻名：大象、狮子、花豹、水牛、长颈鹿、河马、鳄鱼和珍稀的非洲野犬。偏远位置和辽阔空间带来不受打扰的邂逅。游客可在近乎原始的生态系统中体验经典驱车游猎、徒步游猎和鲁菲吉河游船。荒野、生物多样性加上游客稀少，成就专属而富冒险感的非洲游猎。

Mount Ol Doinyo Lengai, rising to approximately 2,962 meters (9,718 feet), is one of Tanzania’s most unique and spiritually significant mountains. Known as the “Mountain of God” by the Maasai people, Ol Doinyo Lengai is the only active volcano in the world that erupts natrocarbonatite lava, a rare type of lava that is cooler, darker, and more fluid than typical basaltic lava. Located in the dramatic landscapes of northern Tanzania near Lake Natron, hiking Mount Ol Doinyo Lengai is an adventurous and deeply rewarding experience that combines geology, culture, and raw wilderness.

El Ol Doinyo Lengai, de unos 2,962 metros, es una de las montañas más singulares de Tanzania. Los masái lo llaman la «Montaña de Dios»; es el único volcán activo del mundo que expulsa lava de natrocarbonatita, más fría, oscura y fluida que la basáltica. Cerca del lago Natron, subirlo es una aventura que combina geología, cultura y naturaleza en estado puro.
伦盖火山海拔约2,962米（9,718英尺），是坦桑尼亚最独特、最具精神意义的山峰之一。马赛人称之为“神之山”。它是世界上唯一喷发钠碳酸岩熔岩的活火山，这种罕见熔岩比普通玄武岩熔岩温度更低、颜色更深、流动性更强。它位于坦桑尼亚北部纳特龙湖附近的壮丽地貌中，攀登伦盖是融合地质、文化与原始荒野的冒险体验，收获极丰。

Unlike Mount Kilimanjaro or Mount Meru, Ol Doinyo Lengai is not a multi-day trekking mountain. It is usually climbed overnight in a single, intense ascent, making it ideal for adventurous hikers seeking a physically demanding challenge and a unique volcanic experience.
A diferencia del Kilimanjaro o el Meru, no es un trekking de varios días: suele subirse de noche en un solo ascenso intenso, ideal para quien busca un reto físico y una experiencia volcánica única.
与乞力马扎罗或梅鲁山不同，伦盖并非多日徒步山峰，通常在夜间一次性高强度攀登完成，非常适合追求体能挑战和独特火山体验的探险者。

Mount Ol Doinyo Lengai is located in northern Tanzania, within the Gregory Rift of the Great Rift Valley, near the southern shores of Lake Natron. The mountain lies close to the border with Kenya and is surrounded by vast volcanic plains, lava fields, and Maasai communities. Its remote location offers an untouched wilderness atmosphere and spectacular views of Lake Natron, the Rift Valley escarpments, and neighboring volcanic formations.

Está en el norte de Tanzania, en el Rift Gregory, cerca de la orilla sur del lago Natron y de la frontera con Kenia, rodeado de llanuras volcánicas, campos de lava y comunidades masái, con vistas del lago, los escarpes y volcanes vecinos.
伦盖火山位于坦桑尼亚北部东非大裂谷的格雷戈里裂谷内，靠近纳特龙湖南岸，临近肯尼亚边境，周围是辽阔的火山平原、熔岩地和马赛社区。偏远的位置带来原始荒野氛围，可远眺纳特龙湖、裂谷崖壁和邻近火山地貌。

Lake Natron Tented Camp is situated at the base of Tanzania's only active volcano, Ol Doinyo Lengai (Mountain of God in Maasai), overlooking Lake Natron, a haven for thousands of lesser flamingos and one of the most important flamingo breeding grounds on earth. Lake Natron Tented Camp has 9 semi-luxury guest tents set back in a grove of trees, all fitted with electricity, running water, en suite bathroom (shower, wash basin and flush toilet), a private verandah, comfortable beds with mosquito netting. Other facilities include restaurant & bar, natural swimming pool, laundry, internet service, fly camping, Maasai cultural excursions, Lake Natron excursions with flamingo viewing, waterfall hikes, guided nature walks to Engare Sero River springs, Ol Doinyo Lengai climb, or relax & swim in the crystal clear stream.

Al pie del Ol Doinyo Lengai, con vistas al lago Natron, refugio de miles de flamencos enanos y una de sus zonas de cría más importantes. Tiene 9 tiendas semilujosas entre árboles, con electricidad, agua corriente, baño privado, terraza y camas con mosquitera. Además: restaurante y bar, piscina natural, lavandería, internet, camping móvil, excursiones culturales masái y al lago, cascadas, paseos a los manantiales del río Engare Sero, ascenso al Lengai o baño en el arroyo cristalino.

Stone Town, the historic core of Zanzibar City, is one of East Africa’s most captivating tourism destinations. Recognized as a UNESCO World Heritage Site, this ancient town is a living museum of culture, history, and architecture. With its winding alleys, carved wooden doors, bustling markets, and oceanfront views, Stone Town offers visitors a unique blend of African, Arab, Indian, and European influences that define Zanzibar’s identity.

Stone Town, Patrimonio de la UNESCO, es un museo vivo de cultura, historia y arquitectura. Con callejuelas, puertas talladas, mercados y vistas al mar, ofrece una mezcla única de influencias africanas, árabes, indias y europeas que definen Zanzíbar.
石头城是桑给巴尔市的历史核心、东非最迷人的目的地之一。这座获联合国教科文组织认定的世界遗产古城，是文化、历史与建筑的活博物馆。蜿蜒小巷、雕花木门、热闹市场和海滨景色，融合非洲、阿拉伯、印度和欧洲风情，塑造了桑给巴尔的独特面貌。

Stone Town’s history dates back centuries, serving as a major trading hub along the Indian Ocean. It was once the center of the spice trade and, later, the East African slave trade. Today, many of its historic buildings still stand, telling stories of commerce, culture, and colonial rule.

Durante siglos fue un gran centro comercial del Índico, núcleo del comercio de especias y, más tarde, de la trata de esclavos de África Oriental. Muchos edificios históricos siguen en pie contando historias de comercio, cultura y dominio colonial.
石头城的历史可追溯数百年，曾是印度洋重要贸易枢纽，先后是香料贸易中心和东非奴隶贸易中心。如今许多历史建筑依然矗立，讲述着商贸、文化与殖民统治的故事。

Tourists can visit key landmarks such as the Old Fort (Ngome Kongwe), built in the 17th century by Omani Arabs, and the House of Wonders (Beit-al-Ajaib), once the grandest building in East Africa. The former Slave Market site, now home to the Anglican Cathedral, is a powerful historical attraction that educates visitors about Zanzibar’s role in the slave trade. These sites make Stone Town not only a leisure destination but also a place of learning and reflection.

Puede visitar el Fuerte Antiguo (Ngome Kongwe), construido en el siglo XVII por árabes omaníes, y la Casa de las Maravillas (Beit-al-Ajaib). El antiguo mercado de esclavos, hoy sede de la catedral anglicana, es un lugar impactante para aprender sobre la trata. Stone Town es destino de ocio y también de reflexión.
游客可参观17世纪阿曼阿拉伯人建造的老堡垒（Ngome Kongwe），以及曾是东非最宏伟建筑的奇迹宫（Beit-al-Ajaib）。昔日奴隶市场旧址如今是圣公会大教堂，是了解桑给巴尔在奴隶贸易中角色的重要历史景点。这些地方让石头城既可休闲游览，也可学习与反思。

Nungwi Beach is one of the most iconic and commercially vibrant beach destinations in Zanzibar, located at the northern tip of Unguja Island. Known for its powder-white sand, turquoise waters, and year-round swimming conditions, Nungwi has evolved into a flagship coastal tourism hub in Tanzania. Blending natural beauty with developed hospitality infrastructure, marine adventures, and nightlife, it stands as one of the most marketable coastal destinations in East Africa.

Nungwi, en el extremo norte de Unguja, es conocida por su arena blanca, aguas turquesas y baño todo el año. Se ha convertido en un centro turístico destacado que combina belleza natural, hoteles, aventuras marinas y vida nocturna.
农圭位于温古贾岛北端，是桑给巴尔最具代表性、最热闹的海滩之一。以洁白细沙、碧蓝海水和全年可游泳著称，已发展为坦桑尼亚的旗舰海滨旅游中心，融合自然美景、完善接待设施、海上探险和夜生活，是东非最具吸引力的海岸目的地之一。

Nungwi is situated approximately 60 kilometers from Stone Town and about 1.5 hours by road from Abeid Amani Karume International Airport. Its northern positioning provides a strategic tourism advantage, making it easily accessible for international travelers while maintaining a scenic coastal atmosphere away from urban congestion.
Está a unos 60 km de Stone Town y 1,5 horas del aeropuerto Abeid Amani Karume. Su posición al norte facilita el acceso internacional y mantiene un ambiente costero lejos de la aglomeración urbana.
农圭距石头城约60公里，距阿贝德·阿马尼·卡鲁姆国际机场车程约1.5小时。北部位置交通便利，国际游客容易抵达，又远离城市喧嚣，保有秀美海岸氛围。

Unlike many beaches on Zanzibar’s east coast, Nungwi experiences minimal tidal fluctuations. This allows visitors to swim throughout the day without interruption from extreme low tides. This natural advantage significantly strengthens its competitiveness in beach tourism marketing and enhances visitor satisfaction.
A diferencia de muchas playas del este, Nungwi apenas tiene mareas, por lo que se puede nadar todo el día sin bajamares extremas.
与桑给巴尔东海岸许多海滩不同，农圭潮差很小，全天都可游泳，不受极低潮影响，这一天然优势大大提升了海滩度假体验。

Nestled off the northeast coast of Zanzibar, Mnemba Island is one of the most exclusive and breathtaking tourism destinations in the Indian Ocean. Surrounded by crystal-clear turquoise waters and vibrant coral reefs, this private island has earned a global reputation as a sanctuary for luxury, romance, and eco-conscious travel. For travelers seeking serenity, privacy, and world-class marine experiences, Mnemba Island represents the pinnacle of tropical tourism.

Frente a la costa noreste de Zanzíbar, Mnemba es uno de los destinos más exclusivos y bellos del Índico. Rodeada de aguas turquesas y arrecifes de coral, esta isla privada es famosa como santuario de lujo, romance y turismo responsable, con experiencias marinas de primer nivel.
姆内姆巴岛依偎在桑给巴尔东北海岸外，是印度洋最尊享、最令人赞叹的目的地之一。这座私人岛屿环绕着清澈碧水和绚丽珊瑚礁，以奢华、浪漫和环保旅行的圣地享誉全球。对追求宁静、私密和世界级海洋体验的旅行者而言，姆内姆巴代表热带旅游的巅峰。

nemba Island is a small, privately owned island known for its exclusivity. Unlike other beach destinations that bustle with crowds, Mnemba offers an intimate escape. With limited guest accommodations, visitors enjoy personalized service, secluded beachfront bandas (thatched luxury villas), and uninterrupted views of the ocean. The absence of mass tourism infrastructure enhances its charm, allowing guests to fully disconnect from daily life and reconnect with nature.

Mnemba es una pequeña isla privada conocida por su exclusividad. Ofrece una escapada íntima, con pocas plazas, servicio personalizado, bandas (villas de paja) frente al mar y vistas ininterrumpidas, para desconectar y reconectar con la naturaleza.
姆内姆巴是一座以尊享著称的小型私人岛屿。与人潮拥挤的海滩不同，这里是私密的世外之所。客房数量有限，服务贴心个性化，隐秘的海滨 banda（茅草顶豪华别墅）面朝无遮挡海景。没有大众旅游设施反而更添魅力，让客人彻底远离日常、重归自然。

This exclusivity makes Mnemba particularly popular among honeymooners, celebrities, and high-end travelers. The island has hosted international figures seeking privacy and tranquility, further elevating its status as a premier luxury destination in East Africa.
Esta exclusividad la hace muy popular entre recién casados, celebridades y viajeros de alto nivel. Ha acogido a figuras internacionales en busca de privacidad.
这份尊享使姆内姆巴尤受蜜月旅行者、名人和高端旅客青睐。岛上接待过寻求私密与宁静的国际人士，进一步确立其东非顶级奢华目的地的地位。

Chole Island is a small, peaceful island located in the Mafia Archipelago off the southern coast of Tanzania. Known for its rich Swahili history, untouched marine environment, and relaxed island lifestyle, it is one of the most authentic and less-crowded destinations in the Indian Ocean. Unlike busier islands such as Zanzibar, it offers a raw and intimate experience, making it perfect for travelers seeking nature, culture, and tranquility.

Chole, en el archipiélago de Mafia, es conocida por su rica historia suajili, su mar intacto y su vida relajada: uno de los destinos más auténticos y menos concurridos del Índico. Ofrece una experiencia íntima, perfecta para quien busca naturaleza, cultura y calma.
乔莱岛位于坦桑尼亚南部海岸的马菲亚群岛，以丰富的斯瓦希里历史、未受破坏的海洋环境和悠闲海岛生活著称，是印度洋最本真、游人最少的目的地之一。与桑给巴尔等热闹海岛不同，这里提供原生态的亲密体验，非常适合追求自然、文化和宁静的旅行者。

It lies just a short boat ride from Mafia Island and is part of the Mafia Island Marine Park. Surrounded by mangroves, coral reefs, and turquoise waters, the island is easily accessible via Mafia Island, which can be reached by domestic flights from Dar es Salaam.

Está a un corto trayecto en barco de la isla de Mafia y forma parte de su Parque Marino. Rodeada de manglares, arrecifes y aguas turquesas, se accede vía Mafia, con vuelos nacionales desde Dar es Salaam.
从马菲亚岛乘船片刻即达，它是马菲亚岛海洋公园的一部分。周围红树林、珊瑚礁和碧蓝海水环绕，经马菲亚岛可轻松抵达，后者有来自达累斯萨拉姆的国内航班。

The island has a fascinating history dating back to the 18th and 19th centuries when it was an important trading center for merchants dealing in coconuts, copra, and spices. Today, remnants of old Swahili ruins, ancient mosques, and colonial buildings can still be seen scattered across the island. The local community maintains strong Swahili traditions, offering visitors a genuine cultural experience.

Su historia se remonta a los siglos XVIII y XIX, cuando fue un importante centro comercial de cocos, copra y especias. Aún se ven ruinas suajilis, mezquitas antiguas y edificios coloniales, y la comunidad mantiene sus tradiciones.
小岛历史可追溯至18、19世纪，当时是椰子、椰干和香料商人的重要贸易中心。如今岛上仍散布着斯瓦希里古迹、古老清真寺和殖民时期建筑。当地社区保持浓厚的斯瓦希里传统，带给游客真实的文化体验。

Mafia es uno de los destinos costeros más vírgenes y auténticos de Tanzania. Al sur de Zanzíbar, es conocida por sus aguas cristalinas, rica biodiversidad marina y ambiente relajado.
马菲亚岛是坦桑尼亚最原生态、最本真的海岸目的地之一。位于桑给巴尔以南的印度洋上，以清澈海水、丰富的海洋生物多样性和悠闲氛围著称。
Unlike busier beach destinations, Mafia Island offers tranquility, natural beauty, and some of the best diving and snorkeling experiences in East Africa.
A diferencia de playas más concurridas, ofrece tranquilidad, belleza natural y algunas de las mejores experiencias de buceo y esnórquel de África Oriental.
与热闹的海滩目的地不同，马菲亚岛带来宁静、自然之美，以及东非一流的潜水和浮潜体验。

Mafia Island lies about 120 kilometers south of Dar es Salaam and is part of the Mafia Archipelago. It is accessible by a short domestic flight from Dar es Salaam or Zanzibar. The island is home to the Mafia Island Marine Park, Tanzania’s first marine park, established to protect its coral reefs and marine life.

Está a unos 120 km al sur de Dar es Salaam, en el archipiélago de Mafia, con vuelos cortos desde Dar es Salaam o Zanzíbar. Alberga el Parque Marino de Mafia, el primero de Tanzania, creado para proteger sus arrecifes y vida marina.

What is the calving season?
¿Qué es la temporada de partos?
什么是产仔季？

Every year, around one and a half million wildebeest gather on the short-grass plains of the southern <a1>Serengeti</a1> and the Ndutu area. Within a few weeks, hundreds of thousands of calves are born. Most are born in the same short period, which is a survival strategy: predators cannot eat them all, and a calf can stand and run within minutes of birth.

Cada año, alrededor de un millón y medio de ñus se reúnen en las praderas de hierba corta del sur del <a1>Serengeti</a1> y Ndutu. En pocas semanas nacen cientos de miles de crías, casi todas en el mismo periodo breve: una estrategia de supervivencia, pues los depredadores no pueden comerlas todas y una cría corre a los pocos minutos.
每年约150万头角马聚集在<a1>塞伦盖蒂</a1>南部和恩杜图地区的矮草平原。几周内数十万幼崽降生，且大多集中在同一短时期——这是一种生存策略：捕食者吃不完所有幼崽，而幼崽出生几分钟内就能站立奔跑。

When does it happen?
¿Cuándo ocurre?
什么时候发生？

The peak is usually February, and births begin in late January and continue into March. The exact timing follows the rains, so it shifts a little each year. The herds spread across the plains, and a good guide follows where the newest calves are.

El punto álgido suele ser febrero; los nacimientos empiezan a finales de enero y siguen en marzo. La fecha depende de las lluvias y varía cada año. Las manadas se dispersan y un buen guía sigue a las crías más recientes.
高峰通常在2月，1月下旬开始产仔，持续到3月。确切时间随雨水而定，每年略有变化。兽群散布平原，好向导会追随最新出生的幼崽。

Why the southern plains?
¿Por qué las llanuras del sur?
为什么在南部平原？

The volcanic ash from the nearby highlands makes the grass here rich in minerals. Mothers need that nutrition to produce milk. The short grass also lets mothers see predators coming from a long way off.
La ceniza volcánica de las tierras altas hace la hierba rica en minerales, que las madres necesitan para producir leche. La hierba corta además permite ver venir a los depredadores desde lejos.
邻近高地的火山灰使这里的草富含矿物质，母兽需要这些营养产奶。矮草也让母兽能远远发现捕食者。

Predators and drama
Depredadores y drama
捕食者与惊险场面

Where there are newborns, there are hunters. Lions, cheetahs, spotted hyenas, jackals and leopards in the Ndutu woodlands all take advantage of the season. You will see hunts, chases and also gentle moments, as mothers nudge new calves to their feet. This is wildlife viewing at its most raw, and some scenes are not for everyone.

Donde hay recién nacidos hay cazadores. Leones, guepardos, hienas manchadas, chacales y leopardos de los bosques de Ndutu aprovechan la temporada. Verá cacerías y persecuciones, pero también ternura cuando las madres animan a las crías a levantarse. Es la naturaleza en estado puro y algunas escenas no son para todos.
有新生幼崽就有猎手。狮子、猎豹、斑鬣狗、胡狼和恩杜图林地的花豹都趁此季节出击。您会看到捕猎和追逐，也有母兽轻推新生幼崽站起的温情时刻。这是最原始的野生动物观赏，有些场面并非人人能接受。

Depredadores y drama: safari en Tanzania

Lake Ndutu, on the border of the Serengeti and the Ngorongoro Conservation Area, is the heart of the <a1>calving season</a1>, with the nearby Kusini plains and the Gol and Naabi areas. Stay at least two or three nights so your guide can follow the herds. See our 5-day Ndutu calving season and <a2>Ngorongoro Crater</a2> safari for a short option, or the 7-day February calving season safari for more time.

El lago Ndutu, entre el Serengeti y el Área de Conservación del Ngorongoro, es el corazón de la <a1>temporada de partos</a1>, con las llanuras de Kusini y las zonas de Gol y Naabi. In January the herds are gathering on the southern plains and the grass is green after the short rains. Births have started in late January in some years. The advantage is quieter camps and slightly lower prices, and you see the build-up to the calving peak. The risk is that the first calves may be only a few days away.

En enero las manadas se reúnen en el sur y la hierba está verde tras las lluvias cortas. Algunos años los partos empiezan a finales de mes. La ventaja: campamentos más tranquilos y precios algo menores, y se ve la antesala del pico. El riesgo es que las primeras crías aún tarden unos días.
1月兽群向南部平原聚集，短雨季后草色翠绿。有些年份1月下旬已开始产仔。优势是营地清静、价格略低，还能看到高峰前的聚集；风险是第一批幼崽可能还要几天才出生。
February: the peak
Febrero: el punto álgido

February is the best-known month for calving. The plains are covered with herds and newborns, and predators are very active. It is also the busiest and most expensive time, so book early. If seeing as many calves as possible is your priority, choose the first three weeks of February.

Febrero es el mes más conocido. Las llanuras se cubren de manadas y recién nacidos, y los depredadores están muy activos. También es lo más concurrido y caro, así que reserve pronto. Si quiere ver el máximo de crías, elija las tres primeras semanas.
2月是最著名的产仔月份。平原上遍布兽群和新生幼崽，捕食者非常活跃。同时也是人最多、价格最高的时期，请尽早预订。若想看到尽可能多的幼崽，请选2月前三周。

March: the herds begin to move

In March births slow down and the herds start to spread out and move west and north. You still see many calves, now a few weeks old and running with their mothers. Crowds thin out, and green-season light is good for photography. Rain is more likely as March goes on.

En marzo disminuyen los nacimientos y las manadas se dispersan hacia el oeste y el norte. Aún se ven muchas crías, ya de semanas y corriendo con sus madres. Hay menos gente y la luz de la temporada verde es buena para fotos. La lluvia es más probable conforme avanza el mes.
3月产仔放缓，兽群开始分散并向西、向北移动。仍能看到许多已数周大、随母奔跑的幼崽。游人减少，绿季光线适合摄影。越到月末降雨可能性越大。

天气如何？

Ndutu is green and warm in these months, with short rain showers that are usually brief. Mornings can be cool, so bring a fleece. Roads can be muddy after heavy rain, but a good 4x4 and guide handle it.
Ndutu está verde y cálido, con chubascos normalmente breves. Las mañanas pueden ser frescas: lleve un forro polar. Tras lluvias fuertes hay barro, pero un buen 4x4 y guía lo resuelven.

Herds of wildebeest and zebra gather on the river bank for hours, sometimes days, before one animal commits and the rest follow. Crocodiles and big cats wait nearby. It is thrilling and unpredictable, which is why we never promise a crossing on a particular day.

The herds move back and forth across the river, so the same herd may cross several times. Rainfall and herd movements change from year to year, so ask us what the herds are doing close to your dates.

Los cruces son posibles aproximadamente de julio a octubre, con el norte del <a1>Serengeti</a1> como escenario principal. Las manadas van y vienen, así que una misma puede cruzar varias veces. Cada año varían: pregúntenos dónde están cerca de sus fechas.

<a1>Kilimanjaro</a1> is a walk, not a technical climb, but altitude is the challenge. The best predictor of reaching the summit is how slowly you gain height. A longer route gives your body more time to adapt, and that matters more than fitness alone.

El <a1>Kilimanjaro</a1> es una caminata, no escalada técnica, pero la altitud es el reto. Lo que mejor predice la cumbre es ganar altura despacio. Una ruta larga da más tiempo para adaptarse, y eso pesa más que la forma física.
<a1>乞力马扎罗</a1>是徒步而非技术攀登，但海拔是挑战。能否登顶最关键在于上升速度够不够慢。较长路线让身体有更多时间适应，这比体能更重要。

Machame route

马查梅路线

Often called the whiskey route, Machame is the most popular choice. It climbs high and sleeps low, which helps acclimatisation, and the scenery changes from rainforest to moorland to the Barranco Wall. It is usually done in six or seven days, and it is steady rather than easy. See our 6-day Machame trek.

Llamada la ruta del whisky, es la más popular. Se sube alto y se duerme bajo, lo que ayuda a aclimatarse, y el paisaje pasa de selva a páramo y al muro Barranco. Suele hacerse en seis o siete días; es constante más que fácil. Vea nuestro trekking de 6 días.
马查梅常称“威士忌路线”，最受欢迎。“爬高睡低”利于适应，景观从雨林、高沼地到巴兰科岩壁。通常6或7天完成，节奏稳健但并不轻松。请看我们的6天马查梅徒步。

Marangu, sometimes called the Coca-Cola route, is the only one with hut accommodation instead of tents. It is short and direct, but the fast ascent in five or six days means a lower summit rate, and the same path is used for the descent. It suits people who prefer a bed to a tent and who are already well acclimatised.

If you can spare the time, choose the longer route. Train with long hikes in the boots you will wear, and plan an extra night in <a1>Arusha</a1> before the climb. Pack warm layers: the summit night is cold. A reputable operator pays porters fairly and carries safety equipment such as an oxygen supply and a pulse oximeter.

Si puede, elija la ruta larga. Entrene con caminatas largas con sus botas y añada una noche en <a1>Arusha</a1> antes. Lleve capas: la noche de cumbre es fría. Un operador serio paga bien a los porteadores y lleva oxígeno y pulsioxímetro.

The herds cross between the two countries following the rains. Tanzania hosts them for most of the year: calving around Ndutu from January to March, the western corridor in May and June, and the northern Serengeti and Mara River crossings from roughly July to October. Kenya sees the herds in the Maasai Mara mainly from July to October. No operator can promise a crossing on a given day, so plan several days in the right area.

Las manadas cruzan entre ambos países siguiendo las lluvias. Tanzania las acoge casi todo el año: partos en Ndutu de enero a marzo, corredor occidental en mayo y junio, y norte y cruces del Mara de julio a octubre. Kenia las ve en el Maasai Mara sobre todo de julio a octubre. Nadie puede prometer un cruce un día concreto: planifique varios.

Pack in layers. Mornings on a game drive are cold, midday is hot and the <a1>Ngorongoro Crater</a1> rim can feel chilly even in the dry season. Choose neutral colours such as khaki, olive and tan. Avoid bright white and very dark blue or black, which dust shows and which can attract tsetse flies in some areas. Bring a warm fleece or light down jacket, a rain shell, long trousers, two or three short and long sleeved shirts, a sun hat and comfortable closed shoes.

Vista por capas: mañanas frías, mediodía caluroso y el borde del <a1>cráter</a1> fresco incluso en seco. Colores neutros (caqui, oliva, beige); evite blanco y azul muy oscuro o negro, que muestran el polvo y pueden atraer moscas tsetsé. Lleve forro o plumas ligero, chubasquero, pantalón largo, dos o tres camisas, sombrero y calzado cerrado.
请分层穿衣。清晨游猎寒冷、中午炎热，<a1>恩戈罗恩戈罗火山口</a1>边缘即使旱季也偏凉。选卡其、橄榄、棕褐等中性色；避免亮白、深蓝或黑色（易显尘土，部分地区会引来采采蝇）。带抓绒或轻羽绒、防雨外套、长裤、两三件长短袖、遮阳帽和舒适的包头鞋。

The Machame Route, also known as the “Whiskey Route,” is one of the most scenic and popular paths to the summit of Mount Kilimanjaro (5,895m). This route offers excellent acclimatization through gradual altitude gain and diverse landscapes, including lush rainforest, open moorland, alpine desert, and glacial terrain.

La ruta Machame, conocida como la «ruta del whisky», es uno de los caminos más bellos y populares a la cumbre del Kilimanjaro (5,895 m). Ofrece una excelente aclimatización por su ganancia gradual de altitud y paisajes diversos: selva exuberante, páramo abierto, desierto alpino y terreno glaciar.
马查梅路线又称“威士忌路线”，是登顶乞力马扎罗山（5,895米）风景最美、最受欢迎的路线之一。该路线海拔逐步上升，高原适应效果好，景观多样：茂密雨林、开阔高沼地、高山荒漠和冰川地貌。

Trekkers enjoy breathtaking views of the Shira Plateau, Barranco Wall, and Kibo Peak before making the unforgettable midnight ascent to Uhuru Peak, the highest point in Africa. The descent follows the Mweka Route, completing a rewarding and well-balanced Kilimanjaro adventure with a high summit success rate.

Los excursionistas disfrutan de vistas impresionantes de la meseta Shira, el muro Barranco y el pico Kibo antes del inolvidable ascenso a medianoche al pico Uhuru, el punto más alto de África. El descenso sigue la ruta Mweka y completa una aventura equilibrada y gratificante con alta tasa de éxito en la cumbre.
登山者可饱览希拉高原、巴兰科岩壁和基博峰的壮丽景色，随后在午夜踏上难忘的冲顶之路，直抵非洲最高点乌呼鲁峰。下山走姆韦卡路线，为这趟收获满满、节奏均衡、登顶成功率高的乞力马扎罗之旅画上句号。

This is a crucial acclimatization day. Trek uphill to Lava Tower (4,630m), then descend into the stunning Barranco Valley. The “climb high, sleep low” approach helps your body adjust to altitude while offering spectacular views of the Breach Wall and glaciers.Hiking Time: 6–8 hours

Día clave de aclimatación. Subida hasta la Lava Tower (4,630 m) y descenso al impresionante valle Barranco. El método «subir alto, dormir bajo» ayuda al cuerpo a adaptarse a la altitud, con vistas espectaculares del muro Breach y los glaciares. Tiempo de marcha: 6–8 horas
这是关键的适应日。向上徒步至熔岩塔（4,630米），再下到壮丽的巴兰科山谷。“爬高睡低”的方式帮助身体适应海拔，沿途可观赏布里奇岩壁和冰川的壮观景象。徒步时间：6–8小时

After breakfast, climb the famous Barranco Wall, a fun and rewarding scramble with panoramic views. Continue across ridges and valleys to Karanga Camp, then proceed to Barafu Camp, your base camp for the summit attempt. Spend the afternoon resting, hydrating, and preparing for the climb.Hiking Time: 6–8 hours

Después del desayuno, ascenso al famoso muro Barranco, una trepada divertida y gratificante con vistas panorámicas. Continúe por crestas y valles hasta el campamento Karanga y luego a Barafu, el campamento base para la cumbre. Tarde para descansar, hidratarse y prepararse. Tiempo de marcha: 6–8 horas
早餐后攀爬著名的巴兰科岩壁，过程有趣且收获感十足，视野开阔。翻越山脊和山谷至卡兰加营地，再前往冲顶大本营巴拉夫营地。下午休息、补水，为冲顶做准备。徒步时间：6–8小时

Begin the summit attempt around midnight. Trek slowly under the stars to Stella Point, then continue to Uhuru Peak (5,895m), the highest point in Africa, arriving at sunrise. After photos and celebration, descend carefully to Mweka Camp for a well-earned rest.Hiking Time: 10–14 hours

El intento de cumbre empieza hacia medianoche. Avance despacio bajo las estrellas hasta Stella Point y continúe al pico Uhuru (5,895 m), el punto más alto de África, llegando al amanecer. Tras las fotos y la celebración, descenso con cuidado al campamento Mweka para un merecido descanso. Tiempo de marcha: 10–14 horas
午夜前后开始冲顶。在星空下缓步行至斯特拉点，继续前往非洲最高点乌呼鲁峰（5,895米），日出时分抵达。拍照庆祝后小心下撤至姆韦卡营地，好好休息。徒步时间：10–14小时

Arrival in Arusha – City & Cultural Experience
Llegada a Arusha: ciudad y cultura
抵达阿鲁沙——城市与文化体验

Welcome to Tanzania! Upon arrival in Arusha, meet your local representative and begin your Arusha city experience. Visit the Maasai Market, where you can discover traditional crafts, artwork, fabrics, and souvenirs. Continue to the Cultural Heritage Centre to explore Tanzania’s rich artistic and cultural history, followed by a visit to a local Arusha market to experience everyday life and local trading. You will also visit the Arusha Clock Tower, one of the city’s well-known landmarks. In the evening, meet your tour consultant for a safari briefing and introduction to your professional guide, who will accompany you throughout the safari.

¡Bienvenido a Tanzania! Al llegar a Arusha, conozca a su representante local y empiece a descubrir la ciudad. Visite el mercado masái, con artesanía, arte, telas y recuerdos tradicionales. Continúe al Cultural Heritage Centre para explorar la rica historia artística y cultural del país, y después un mercado local para vivir la vida cotidiana. Verá también la Torre del Reloj, uno de los puntos más conocidos de la ciudad. Por la noche, reunión con su asesor para el briefing del safari y presentación de su guía profesional, que le acompañará durante todo el viaje.
欢迎来到坦桑尼亚！抵达阿鲁沙后与当地代表会合，开启城市体验。参观马赛市场，欣赏传统手工艺品、艺术品、布料和纪念品；前往文化遗产中心了解坦桑尼亚丰富的艺术与文化历史；再逛当地市场感受日常生活与买卖。您还将看到阿鲁沙钟楼这一城市地标。晚上与行程顾问会面听取游猎说明，认识全程陪同您的专业向导。
