Experience the magic of Tanzania's wilderness on a remarkable 7-day mid-range safari designed around the spectacular Great Wildebeest Migration in Northern Serengeti. This unforgettable adventure combines exceptional wildlife encounters, breathtaking landscapes and comfortable mid-range accommodation, bringing you closer to one of the greatest natural spectacles in Tanzania Savanna.
Viva la magia de la naturaleza en este safari de 7 días en torno a la Gran Migración del norte del Serengeti, que combina encuentros excepcionales, paisajes y alojamiento cómodo de gama media.
在这趟以塞伦盖蒂北部角马大迁徙为主题的7天中档游猎中感受坦桑尼亚荒野魅力。本行程融合绝佳的野生动物邂逅、壮丽风光和舒适的中档住宿，让您走近坦桑尼亚稀树草原上最伟大的自然奇观之一。

Explore the wildlife-rich plains of Tarangire National Park, discover the magnificent Ngorongoro Crater and journey into the legendary Serengeti ecosystem, where endless savannah plains provide a home to Africa's most iconic wildlife.
Explore las llanuras de Tarangire, descubra el cráter del Ngorongoro y adéntrese en el ecosistema del Serengeti, hogar de la fauna más emblemática.
探索动物丰富的塔兰吉雷平原，发现壮丽的恩戈罗恩戈罗火山口，深入传奇的塞伦盖蒂生态系统——无垠稀树草原是非洲标志性动物的家园。

The highlight of your adventure is Northern Serengeti, where you will follow the movements of thousands of wildebeest and zebras as they journey across the plains in search of fresh grazing grounds. Spend valuable time exploring the famous Mara River ecosystem, with opportunities to witness the dramatic river crossings that make this migration one of Africa's most extraordinary wildlife experiences.
Lo culminante es el norte del Serengeti, siguiendo a miles de ñus y cebras en busca de pastos, con tiempo en el río Mara y ocasión de ver los cruces.
行程高潮在塞伦盖蒂北部，追随成千上万穿越平原寻找鲜草的角马和斑马。用充足时间探索著名的马拉河生态区，有机会目睹惊险渡河——这正是大迁徙成为非洲最非凡野生动物体验的原因。

Throughout your safari, enjoy opportunities to encounter lions, leopards, cheetahs, elephants, giraffes and numerous other wildlife species. At Ngorongoro Crater, explore a remarkable natural sanctuary with opportunities to encounter the Big Five, including the endangered black rhino.
Podrá ver leones, leopardos, guepardos, elefantes y jirafas. En el Ngorongoro, ocasión de ver a los cinco grandes, incluido el rinoceronte negro.
全程有机会邂逅狮子、花豹、猎豹、大象、长颈鹿和众多动物。在恩戈罗恩戈罗火山口这座非凡的天然庇护所，有机会看到非洲五霸，包括濒危黑犀牛。
After exciting days of game drives, relax in carefully selected mid-range lodges and tented camps that combine comfort, welcoming hospitality and an authentic African safari atmosphere.
Tras los recorridos, descanse en lodges y campamentos de gama media escogidos, con comodidad y hospitalidad.
精彩游猎之后，在精心挑选的中档酒店和帐篷营地休息，享受舒适、热情款待与地道的非洲游猎氛围。
Arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport - Transfer to Arusha
Llegada al aeropuerto del Kilimanjaro – traslado a Arusha
抵达乞力马扎罗国际机场 – 前往阿鲁沙

Upon arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport, you will be warmly welcomed by your safari representative and transferred to your hotel in Arusha. During the drive, enjoy views of the beautiful Tanzanian countryside, with its green landscapes, local villages and, weather permitting, distant views of Mount Meru.
A su llegada, su representante le trasladará al hotel en Arusha, entre paisajes verdes, aldeas y, con buen tiempo, vistas del monte Meru.
抵达乞力马扎罗国际机场后，游猎代表热情迎接并送您到阿鲁沙酒店。途中欣赏坦桑尼亚秀美乡村：绿色田野、当地村落，天气好时可远眺梅鲁山。

Arusha is the main gateway to Tanzania's famous Northern Safari Circuit and an ideal starting point for your wildlife adventure. After checking in, you will have time to relax and recover from your international journey. Depending on your arrival time, you may also receive a short safari briefing to prepare for the adventure ahead.
Arusha es la puerta del circuito norte y el punto de partida ideal. Tiempo para descansar y, según la hora, un breve briefing.
阿鲁沙是著名北部游猎环线的主要门户，也是理想起点。入住后休息缓解旅途疲劳。视抵达时间，可能进行简短行前说明。
Arusha - Tarangire National Park - Karatu
Arusha – Tarangire – Karatu
阿鲁沙 – 塔兰吉雷国家公园 – 卡拉图

After breakfast, depart Arusha and drive towards Tarangire National Park for your first wildlife experience. The journey takes you through the scenic landscapes of northern Tanzania before entering a park famous for its impressive elephant population, ancient baobab trees and diverse wildlife.
Después del desayuno, trayecto a Tarangire, famoso por sus elefantes, baobabs y fauna diversa.
早餐后从阿鲁沙驱车前往塔兰吉雷国家公园开启首次游猎。沿途经过坦桑尼亚北部秀美风光，进入以庞大象群、古老猴面包树和多样动物闻名的公园。

Tarangire offers a distinctive safari atmosphere, with open savannah, seasonal swamps, acacia woodlands and the Tarangire River, which provides an important water source for wildlife, particularly during the dry season.
Tarangire ofrece sabana abierta, humedales estacionales, acacias y el río Tarangire, vital en la estación seca.
塔兰吉雷游猎氛围独特：开阔草原、季节性沼泽、金合欢林地，以及在旱季尤为重要的水源塔兰吉雷河。

During your game drive, look out for large elephant families moving through the park, sometimes gathering beneath the enormous baobab trees. Other wildlife commonly found here includes giraffes, zebras, wildebeest, buffaloes, impalas and warthogs. With some luck, you may also encounter predators such as lions, leopards and cheetahs.
Busque familias de elefantes bajo los baobabs, además de jirafas, cebras, ñus, búfalos, impalas, facóqueros y, con suerte, leones, leopardos y guepardos.
游猎中寻找在公园中穿行、有时聚在巨大猴面包树下的大象家族。常见动物还有长颈鹿、斑马、角马、水牛、黑斑羚和疣猪。运气好还能遇到狮子、花豹和猎豹。

Tarangire is also an excellent destination for bird enthusiasts, with a wide variety of colourful and fascinating bird species. Enjoy a picnic lunch at a designated site before continuing your afternoon game drive.
Excelente también para las aves. Pícnic antes de continuar por la tarde.
塔兰吉雷也是观鸟胜地，鸟种丰富多彩。在指定地点野餐午餐后继续下午游猎。
In the late afternoon, exit the park and continue towards Karatu, a charming highland town surrounded by fertile farmland and beautiful green landscapes near the Ngorongoro Conservation Area.
A última hora, salida hacia Karatu, un pueblo de montaña rodeado de campos fértiles cerca del Ngorongoro.
傍晚出园前往卡拉图——一座靠近恩戈罗恩戈罗保护区、被沃野绿景环绕的迷人高地小镇。
Karatu - Central Serengeti National Park
Karatu – Serengeti central
卡拉图 – 塞伦盖蒂中部

After breakfast, depart Karatu and travel towards the world-famous Serengeti National Park through the Ngorongoro Conservation Area. This journey offers beautiful scenery as you move from the cooler highlands towards the vast open plains of the Serengeti.
Después del desayuno, camino al Serengeti por el Área de Conservación del Ngorongoro, de las tierras altas frescas a las llanuras.
早餐后离开卡拉图，穿越恩戈罗恩戈罗保护区前往举世闻名的塞伦盖蒂。沿途从凉爽高地过渡到辽阔平原，风光秀美。

The Serengeti is one of Africa's most celebrated wildlife destinations, famous for its endless grasslands, remarkable biodiversity and the Great Wildebeest Migration. Its diverse habitats support an impressive range of wildlife throughout the year.
El Serengeti es famoso por sus praderas, biodiversidad y la Gran Migración, con fauna todo el año.
塞伦盖蒂是非洲最负盛名的野生动物胜地之一，以无尽草原、惊人的生物多样性和角马大迁徙著称，多样生境全年养育丰富动物。

Upon entering the Central Serengeti, particularly the Seronera region, begin exploring one of the park's most rewarding wildlife areas. This region is known for its resident wildlife and strong predator population, making it an excellent place to search for lions, leopards and cheetahs.
En la región de Seronera, conocida por su fauna residente y depredadores, busque leones, leopardos y guepardos.
进入塞伦盖蒂中部尤其是塞罗内拉地区后，开始探索园内收获最丰的区域之一。这里以常驻动物和大量捕食者闻名，是寻找狮子、花豹和猎豹的好地方。

The Seronera River and its surrounding woodland provide important habitats for wildlife, while the nearby plains attract large numbers of grazing animals. You may also visit the famous Seronera Hippo Pool, where hippos can often be observed resting together in the water.
El río Seronera y sus bosques son hábitats clave. Puede visitar la poza de hipopótamos de Seronera.
塞罗内拉河及周边林地是重要栖息地，附近平原吸引大量食草动物。还可游览著名的塞罗内拉河马池，常能看到河马挤在水中休憩。
Enjoy your game drive as you explore the Central Serengeti's diverse landscapes, looking for elephants, giraffes, buffaloes, zebras, wildebeest and many other species.
Explore los paisajes del Serengeti central buscando elefantes, jirafas, búfalos, cebras, ñus y más.
游猎穿行塞伦盖蒂中部多样地貌，寻找大象、长颈鹿、水牛、斑马、角马等众多物种。
Central Serengeti - Northern Serengeti National Park
Serengeti central – norte del Serengeti
塞伦盖蒂中部 – 北部

After breakfast, begin your journey towards the Northern Serengeti, enjoying a game drive along the way. This is an exciting day as you travel through different sections of the Serengeti ecosystem, following the seasonal movements of wildlife.
Después del desayuno, safari hacia el norte por distintas partes del ecosistema, siguiendo la fauna estacional.
早餐后启程北上，沿途游猎。这是激动人心的一天，穿越塞伦盖蒂生态系统的不同区域，追随动物的季节性动向。

The Northern Serengeti is particularly famous for the Great Wildebeest Migration, especially the areas surrounding the Mara River. During the migration season, enormous herds of wildebeest and zebras move through this region in search of fresh grazing and water.
El norte es famoso por la Gran Migración, sobre todo en torno al río Mara, con enormes manadas en busca de pastos y agua.
塞伦盖蒂北部以角马大迁徙闻名，尤其是马拉河周边。迁徙季节庞大的角马和斑马群穿行此地寻找鲜草和水源。

The landscape becomes increasingly varied as you travel north, with open grasslands, rolling hills, rocky outcrops and riverine vegetation. These habitats support resident wildlife as well as migratory herds, offering opportunities to encounter elephants, giraffes, buffaloes, lions, leopards and other animals.
El paisaje se vuelve más variado: praderas, colinas, rocas y vegetación de ribera, con elefantes, jirafas, búfalos, leones y leopardos.
越往北景观越丰富：开阔草原、起伏丘陵、岩石露头和河岸植被，养育着常驻动物和迁徙兽群，有机会看到大象、长颈鹿、水牛、狮子、花豹等。

As you approach your accommodation, your guide will continue searching for wildlife and assessing activity in the surrounding migration areas. The exact location of the herds changes throughout the season, so your guide will use local knowledge to identify the most promising areas to explore.
Al acercarse al alojamiento, su guía seguirá evaluando la actividad. La ubicación de las manadas cambia, y usará su conocimiento local.
接近住处时，向导继续寻找动物并评估周边迁徙区域的动静。兽群位置整季不断变化，向导凭本地经验判断最有希望的探索区域。
Full-Day Game Drive in Northern Serengeti - Mara River Migration Experience
Día completo en el norte del Serengeti: la migración en el río Mara
塞伦盖蒂北部全天游猎——马拉河迁徙体验
Today is dedicated to exploring the Northern Serengeti, with a special focus on the Mara River and the Great Wildebeest Migration.
Día dedicado al norte, con foco en el río Mara y la Gran Migración.
今天专门探索塞伦盖蒂北部，重点是马拉河和角马大迁徙。

After an early breakfast, set out for a full-day game drive in search of the migrating herds. The Northern Serengeti is one of the most dramatic locations to experience the migration, particularly when large groups of wildebeest and zebras gather near the riverbanks.
Tras un desayuno temprano, safari de día completo tras las manadas, especialmente cuando se juntan junto a las orillas.
早早用过早餐，全天游猎寻找迁徙兽群。塞伦盖蒂北部是体验大迁徙最震撼的地点之一，尤其当大群角马和斑马聚集河岸时。

The Mara River is a significant obstacle along the migration route. Its steep banks and flowing water make crossing a challenging experience for the animals. When the herds decide to cross, thousands of wildebeest may move towards the river, creating an unforgettable wildlife spectacle. However, river crossings are natural events and cannot be guaranteed, as their timing depends on rainfall, grazing conditions and the movement of the herds.
El río Mara es un gran obstáculo. Cuando las manadas deciden cruzar, miles de ñus se lanzan al agua, pero los cruces no pueden garantizarse: dependen de lluvias, pastos y movimientos.
马拉河是迁徙路线上的一大障碍，陡岸与急流使渡河充满挑战。当兽群决定渡河时，数千角马涌向河水，造就难忘奇观。不过渡河是自然现象，无法保证，时间取决于降雨、草场状况和兽群动向。

Beyond the migration, the Northern Serengeti is also home to resident predators. Lions may be seen resting in the grasslands or watching the herds, while crocodiles inhabit sections of the Mara River. Leopards and other wildlife may also be encountered around the riverine woodland.
Hay además depredadores residentes: leones en las praderas, cocodrilos en el Mara y leopardos en los bosques de ribera.
除迁徙外，北部还有常驻捕食者：草丛中休憩或窥视兽群的狮子、马拉河段栖息的鳄鱼，河岸林地一带也可能遇到花豹和其他动物。

Enjoy a picnic lunch in the wilderness and continue exploring different areas of the Northern Serengeti throughout the day. Your guide will adjust the game-drive route according to wildlife activity and the latest information about the migrating herds.
Pícnic en plena naturaleza y más recorridos, ajustando la ruta según la actividad.
在荒野野餐后全天继续探索北部不同区域。向导根据动物活动和迁徙群最新消息调整路线。
Northern Serengeti - Central Serengeti - Ngorongoro Highlands
Norte del Serengeti – centro – tierras altas del Ngorongoro
塞伦盖蒂北部 – 中部 – 恩戈罗恩戈罗高地
After breakfast, enjoy a morning game drive in the Northern Serengeti, providing another opportunity to explore the migration area and search for wildlife before beginning your journey south.
Después del desayuno, safari matinal en el norte antes de viajar al sur.
早餐后在塞伦盖蒂北部晨间游猎，在南下前再次探索迁徙区域、寻找动物。

You will travel through the Central Serengeti, enjoying a scenic game drive across the vast plains and wildlife-rich habitats. This route offers further opportunities to encounter the Serengeti's resident animals, including elephants, giraffes, zebras, wildebeest and various predators.
Por el Serengeti central, safari panorámico con ocasiones de ver elefantes, jirafas, cebras, ñus y depredadores.
穿越塞伦盖蒂中部，在辽阔平原和动物丰富的生境中风景游猎，进一步邂逅常驻动物：大象、长颈鹿、斑马、角马和各种捕食者。

The Central Serengeti is particularly recognised for its big-cat population. Its rocky kopjes, open grasslands and surrounding woodlands provide important habitats for lions, leopards and cheetahs. Keep your camera ready as your guide searches for interesting wildlife encounters along the way.
El centro destaca por sus grandes felinos entre kopjes, praderas y bosques. Tenga la cámara lista.
中部尤以大型猫科动物数量著称。花岗岩小丘、开阔草原和周边林地是狮子、花豹和猎豹的重要栖息地。请备好相机，向导沿途寻找精彩邂逅。

Continue towards the Ngorongoro Highlands, where the scenery gradually changes from the open Serengeti plains to cooler highland landscapes. The region is characterised by rolling hills, lush vegetation, volcanic features and beautiful views of the surrounding conservation area.
Continúe a las tierras altas del Ngorongoro, de colinas, vegetación frondosa y rasgos volcánicos.
继续前往恩戈罗恩戈罗高地，景色从开阔的塞伦盖蒂平原逐渐变为凉爽高地：起伏丘陵、茂盛植被、火山地貌和保护区美景。
Arrive at your accommodation in the Ngorongoro Highlands in the evening, where you can relax and prepare for the following day's crater adventure.
Llegada al alojamiento al atardecer para descansar y preparar el cráter.
傍晚抵达高地住处休息，为次日火山口之旅做准备。
After an early breakfast, descend into the magnificent Ngorongoro Crater for an unforgettable game drive.
Tras un desayuno temprano, descenso al cráter para un safari inolvidable.
早早用过早餐，下到壮丽的恩戈罗恩戈罗火山口难忘游猎。
The Ngorongoro Crater is one of the world's most remarkable natural wildlife environments.
El cráter es uno de los entornos de fauna más notables del mundo.
恩戈罗恩戈罗火山口是世界上最非凡的天然野生动物环境之一。

Formed by the collapse of a large volcanic mountain, the crater contains a variety of habitats, including open grasslands, freshwater areas, woodland and marshes. These habitats support a remarkable concentration of wildlife throughout the year.
Formado por el colapso de una gran montaña volcánica, tiene praderas, aguas dulces, bosques y humedales con gran concentración de fauna todo el año.
火山口由一座巨大火山坍塌形成，包含开阔草原、淡水区、林地和沼泽等多种生境，全年支撑着极高密度的野生动物。

During your game drive, explore the crater floor in search of the famous Big Five: lions, elephants, buffaloes, leopards and the endangered black rhino. The crater is also home to zebras, wildebeest, hippos, hyenas, jackals and numerous bird species.
Busque a los cinco grandes: leones, elefantes, búfalos, leopardos y rinoceronte negro, además de cebras, ñus, hipopótamos, hienas, chacales y aves.
游猎中在火山口底寻找著名的非洲五霸：狮子、大象、水牛、花豹和濒危黑犀牛。这里还有斑马、角马、河马、鬣狗、胡狼和众多鸟类。
One of the most special experiences is the opportunity to search for the black rhino, a rare and protected species that makes the Ngorongoro Crater an important conservation destination.
Una experiencia especial es buscar el rinoceronte negro, especie rara y protegida que hace del cráter un lugar clave de conservación.
